summary: Vilsau is a bespectacled college roommate who, with a friend, adopted a gentle stranger found sitting in a park. Locals say the stranger kept a toy dog that outlived the lease.

feats.scene: Vilsau shoves a stuck dormitory window open for the stranger.
Vilsau trudges through an afternoon downpour carrying two bags of groceries.

name: Ontcos
summary: Ontcos is a young survivor of a squad experiment who sprouts glassy wings and fires slivers of crystal from a wrist guard. Locals know the soldier as an unmatched code-breaker who dives in from above.

feats.scene: Ontcos fires a volley of crystal slivers that pins a rifleman's sleeves to a wall.
Ontcos is slammed against a stone ledge in mid-dive and keeps flying.
Ontcos folds the wings and dives toward a jungle clearing.

name: Sorvaliar
summary: Sorvaliar is a part-machine gardener who shelters wandering families in a riverside house with a squeaky gate. Chroniclers recall a night spent minding a sleeping child while a stranger left a glowing marble on the sill.

feats.scene: Sorvaliar lifts a fallen porch beam to free a startled cat.
Sorvaliar steps out of a collapsing greenhouse with only dust on the metal knuckles.

name: Nancalose
summary: Nancalose is a blond ranch hand with a famous namesake and a surer aim than any foreman. Songs of the range tell of outlaws roped before breakfast and a shy admirer who never won a dance.

feats.scene: Nancalose snaps a rifle shot clean through the rope that holds a stolen strongbox.
Nancalose is dragged behind a runaway wagon and still lands the lasso.

name: Valont
summary: Valont was a girl whose sudden death on a country road taught a nearby friend that thoughts could be heard from far away. Records mention the friend's cry and never the road itself.

feats.scene: Valont tosses a skipping stone across a pond with a flick of the wrist.
Valont is struck by a speeding car on a narrow road.

name: Vateria
summary: Vateria was a red-haired child whose road accident became the first spark of a gift in the friend beside her. Neighbors laid wildflowers by the verge each spring for years.

feats.scene: Vateria kicks a ball over a hedge to start a game.
Vateria is hit by a car on a wet bend of the road.

name: Tiaineeo
summary: Tiaineeo is a playground friend whose death, in a world where a stolen firebird changed everything, is the only reason that world's heroine learned to hear minds. Chroniclers keep the name and nothing else.

feats.scene: Tiaineeo hurls a snowball that bursts against a fence post.
Tiaineeo is struck by a car at the edge of the schoolyard.

name: Tiatil
summary: Tiatil trained in temple fist fighting from age three and became a famous action star until one stray punch ended a colleague's career. Locals say the retired fighter now teaches spies how to fall without a sound.

feats.scene: Tiatil lands a lightning punch that drops a stuntman on a film set.
Tiatil falls from a balcony rail onto cobbles and rolls upright.

name: Vosnt
summary: Vosnt rules a crowded swarm-kingdom beyond the veil as a green-haired, many-eyed queen who calls councils in times of crisis. Chroniclers praise the clever retreat that spared the rest of the council a long siege.

feats.scene: Vosnt hurls a swarm-lance that cracks a city block into rubble.
Vosnt walks unharmed through a barrage of heavy cannon fire.

name: Llooro
summary: Llooro is a dark elder entity bound under a golden crown, ruler of a hellish world and master of its demon horde. Legends hold that whoever wins the crown takes command, and the world rejoices in every defeat.

feats.scene: Llooro splits a mountain range with a surge of black force.
Llooro stands in the heart of a collapsing peak and the stone parts around the crown.

name: Iumlloli
summary: Iumlloli is a green, insect-headed conscript of a gloomy dimension who explodes in nearly every scene and never finds a sweetheart. Chroniclers keep a tally, and the number is large.

feats.scene: Iumlloli bursts in a blast that wrecks a carriage and rattles the neighbors.
Iumlloli is trampled by a rushing crowd and reforms for the next scene.

name: Tarni
summary: Tarni is a winged tyrant of a gloomy dimension whose captured relic was lifted by a quick-handed visitor. Songs claim that a duel with a masked metal despot drew both near the wall of annihilating matter.

feats.scene: Tarni sweeps a swarm of fliers into a firestorm that levels a metropolis.
Tarni stands against a plasma burst that melts a hillside.

name: Antest
summary: Antest is a bug-faced conqueror whose battered scepter was seized by grieving heroes for a revenge raid on a distant empire. Chroniclers argue about who lost more in that bargain.

feats.scene: Raiders wield the scepter of Antest to burn a fleet of warships in a single sweep.
Antest endures the blast of a star-ship broadside without a scratch.

name: Viornto
summary: Viornto ruled a chain of dark worlds and teamed with a rival warlord against a distant planet, only to be defeated by a plotting armored king. Records disagree on whether the plan was ever more than a bluff.

feats.scene: Viornto breaks a mountain fortress with a thrown bolt of black energy.
Viornto is hurled through a gateway and lands on both feet.

name: Rnintan
summary: Rnintan led a vast insect armada across the stars until a reborn firebird-wielder swept a third of it away. Chroniclers still debate whether the leader died screaming or laughing.

feats.scene: Rnintan's armada strips a whole world to a glowing cinder in a single advance.
Rnintan rides out the impact of a shattered moon without slowing.

name: Valvava
summary: Valvava stood among the defenders of a doomed world until a living planet-eater ate everything, later revealed to be a prankster's playground mock-up. Songs claim the tale is retold with fresh details every time.

feats.scene: Valvava fires a wing-borne burst that blasts a mountain pass to gravel.
Valvava is swallowed by a world-eating hunger and dissolves only after a long moment.

name: Anlli
summary: Anlli is a lone, bat-winged emperor of a distant sector who grows frantic when a realm of the dead begins swallowing neighboring worlds. Chroniclers say a gentle kindness confused the tyrant most.

feats.scene: Anlli shatters a drifting continent of ice with a single beam from the scepter.
Anlli holds the line against a collapsing wall of anti-matter without a tremor.

name: Valteor
summary: Valteor is a would-be world-breaker whose stripped helmet hangs on a wall as a trophy of a masked web-hero, in a world where the conqueror lost. Legends say the loss was swift and embarrassing.

feats.scene: Valteor crushes a delivery truck between two claws.
Valteor is pummeled by a masked hero's flurry and drops the helm.

name: Nttor
summary: Nttor was born on a harsh planet and took forbidden technology to sharpen both muscle and mind, then forged a scepter to focus a growing dread of rivals. Chroniclers count neighboring worlds as the first casualties.

feats.scene: Nttor blasts a rival citadel into glowing slag with a bolt from the scepter.
Nttor wades through a rival's volley and scratches the scepter on the ground.

name: Lusaluine
summary: Lusaluine is a winged conqueror caught by a trickster who plans to collect champions for a stage show. Chroniclers say the scepter and the wings were the only items allowed to stay.

feats.scene: Lusaluine blasts a canyon wall into rubble with a flash from the scepter.
Lusaluine is slammed through a stage set and rises with a snarl.
Lusaluine streaks across the arena on wide wings.

name: Siaunne
summary: Siaunne is a bat-winged invader that burst through a laboratory gateway and attacked a rocky brawler, then fled to menace a city's police. Records end with a spray of insect repellent.

feats.scene: Siaunne smashes the controls of the gateway to prevent a return.
Siaunne is battered by a squad of police fire and keeps advancing.

name: Morniva
summary: Morniva wears a conqueror's helm at a gathering of costumed rogues and may be only a convincing costume. Rumor holds the staff is real and the fear is not.

feats.scene: Morniva swings the staff against a folding chair and splinters it.
Morniva bumps through a crowded hall and is tripped by a spilled drink.

name: Reseo
summary: Reseo is a coined word whispered over a board game, a name that wins a match for a child with a clever tile rack. Chroniclers keep it because a single clever play deserves a footnote.

feats.scene: Reseo is slapped down onto a board by a triumphant hand.
Reseo survives a tabletop being thumped by an excited elbow.

name: Anteltor
summary: Anteltor joined a last stand of former servants of a ravenous planet-eater, with no hope and a stubborn heart. Chroniclers record that the stand ended swiftly.

feats.scene: Anteltor hurls a spear of dark energy that tears a crater across a mountain range.
Anteltor stands in the path of the devourer for a long breath before falling.

name: Neiumni
summary: Neiumni is a bored ruler of a sulky dimension who begs to be let out to play, only to be returned by tireless household robots. Songs depict a tiny crown and an enormous sigh.

feats.scene: Neiumni stomps a toy tower into confetti during a tantrum.
Neiumni is carried off by a robot and doesn't leave a scratch on the floor.

name: Nilonst
summary: Nilonst is a winged warlord who spies a flying child tossed into his domain by a mischievous brother. Records never state who won the brawl.

feats.scene: Nilonst lashes out with a lance that smashes a stone bridge to dust.
Nilonst is knocked tumbling across a field and bounds back up.

name: Cosservo
summary: Cosservo is a cartoon commander of a buzzing army who rules a murky dimension while fleeing bug zappers. Songs claim the cry of this ruler is the loudest and least frightening in the cosmos.

feats.scene: Cosservo points the scepter and a cartoon bolt flattens a hut.
Cosservo is flattened by a falling anvil and pops back up.

name: Aunusmo
summary: Aunusmo started a sweeping invasion and met a green giant that wore the conqueror's face as a shoulder trophy. Records mention the invasion's end only in rumor.

feats.scene: Aunusmo launches a swarm that scorches a plain from horizon to horizon.
Aunusmo is battered by a rage-filled giant before the last wing breaks.

name: Loniaure
summary: Loniaure is a cranky, pink-eyed warlord who allied with a rival and a masked despot to storm a tower, then got knocked back through the gateway. Chroniclers note the world was only a dream made by a friend.

feats.scene: Loniaure breaks a skyscraper lobby apart with a bolt from the scepter.
Loniaure is slapped through the gateway and lands unharmed on the far side.

name: Inali
summary: Inali is a winged lord whose power was drained by a time-wandering conqueror using a siphoning gadget. Records say the conqueror grew stronger and the lord grew quiet.

feats.scene: Inali floods the siphon with a surge that cracks a moon from pole to pole.
Inali is drained of power while standing and does not fall for a long moment.

name: Ceteco
summary: Ceteco is a green conqueror slain by a tall violet tyrant in a bygone age, remembered only through a horde that returned ages later. Songs say the horde carried no banner but his.

feats.scene: Ceteco's horde bombards a mountain chain until the peaks sink.
Ceteco withstands the grip of a titan and is only felled by a second strike.

name: Riarosam
summary: Riarosam is a mutated warlord of a dark vault below a laboratory who was twisted by drifting radiation and faced two daring explorers. Rumor says the transformation was the only argument it ever won.

feats.scene: Riarosam smashes through a reinforced vault door in a single charge.
Riarosam shrugs off a wall of falling girders.

name: Stenine
summary: Stenine is a pale-haired predator who lures the heartbroken into a quiet house and drinks their memories. Chroniclers say a faint scent was the only thing the predator lacked, which is how a mending guest was trapped.

feats.scene: Stenine pins a guest to a banquet table with eight spindly limbs.
Stenine is slashed by a trio of blades and keeps feeding for a moment longer.

name: Tialusco
summary: Tialusco is a soldier-spy of a hidden mountain kingdom who works alongside a sibling to feed secrets to the throne. Locals say the pair never missed a message and never signed one.

feats.scene: Tialusco vaults a palace wall and drops a scroll into the sentry's lap.
Tialusco is tackled by two guards and carries on with the errand.

name: Toneni
summary: Toneni is a bald engineer in a crowded coastal city who welcomes a transformed son home with a worried heart. Songs tell of a dinner cooked and a visit that stretched on.

feats.scene: Toneni hammers a loose bracket back into place on a workshop shelf.
Toneni sits through a long night of worry without complaint.

name: Aussum
summary: Aussum is an ageless keeper of an elixir who haggles with royal sorcerers over the price of a long life. Legends say the keeper judged every offer with a smile and drank none of it.

feats.scene: Aussum collapses a pavilion with one slow wave of the hand.
Aussum stands unmoved as a palace wall topples onto the courtyard.

name: Orcolmor
summary: Orcolmor is a silver-haired territorial magistrate on a dry frontier who turns a hunted rescuer into a lawman. Ledgers say the pardon was kept secret to protect the plan.

feats.scene: Orcolmor pounds a gavel against a bench to quiet a rowdy hall.
Orcolmor endures the heat of a burning corridor before being led to safety.

name: Amanere
summary: Amanere is a smooth buyer for a hostile regime who tries to purchase a supersonic engine and then to steal the planes that carry it. Records note the bid collapsed when a pilot walked into the hideout.

feats.scene: Amanere slams a briefcase of cash onto a negotiating table.
Amanere shrugs off a punch from a furious engineer.

name: Lorval
summary: Lorval is a cautious director of research in a secret mountain installation who always arrives at emergency meetings with the right file. Rumor says every incident since the grand opening is recorded in the same blue folder.

feats.scene: Lorval drops a heavy binder on the table to mark the start of the briefing.
Lorval sits through a break-in alarm and still finishes the sentence.

name: Toestsa
summary: Toestsa was a gray-haired judge who broke the law to buy relief for a suffering spouse and paid for it behind iron bars. Songs say a kind heart cost a quiet man everything.

feats.scene: Toestsa raps a gavel against the bench to call the court to order.
Toestsa takes a vicious wound in a prison yard and does not cry out.

name: Liamure
summary: Liamure is a general who sided with invaders against a poison-wielding tyrant after losing a sister to the regime's gas. Chroniclers call the choice grim and the logic simple.

feats.scene: Liamure fires a service pistol that punches through a barricaded door.
Liamure staggers through a smoke-filled trench and does not fall.

name: Enlumro
summary: Enlumro is a half-built mechanical head left in a workshop, an unfinished idea of a clever tinkerer. Records suggest it still hums softly when no one is listening.

feats.scene: Enlumro rolls off a bench and bumps a pencil across the floor.
Enlumro is dropped down a stairwell and lands without a crack.

name: Tevostu
summary: Tevostu is a loyal worker ant with a tiny helmet who follows a size-changing hero into every skirmish. Colony songs say the ant never lost a crumb.

feats.scene: Tevostu drags a breadcrumb many times its own weight along a windowsill.
Tevostu survives a footstep that crushes the tile beneath it.

name: Oseterlu
summary: Oseterlu is a red-skinned general of a swarming kingdom who led a rebellion for fair elections and lost with dignity. Chroniclers still list the vote count in the margins.

feats.scene: Oseterlu rams a barricade of ore carts and scatters them down the tunnel.
Oseterlu takes a cannon shot against the shoulder plate and keeps marching.

name: Vilaniseo
summary: Vilaniseo is a hired grunt in a crime lord's crew sent to snatch a webbed vigilante at a quiet house. Records say the errand ended with no snatch at all.

feats.scene: Vilaniseo swings a fist at a darting target and clips a doorframe.
Vilaniseo is tossed into a hedge by the vigilante and picks leaves from the collar.

name: Stucortel
summary: Stucortel was once the greatest hunter of the undead and mentor to two famous monster-killers, then was bitten and became their king. Chroniclers say the former teacher stole a suit of golden armor to walk in daylight.

feats.scene: Stucortel drives a gauntleted fist through a stone pillar in a crypt.
Stucortel absorbs a crushing blow from a giant fist and stands in the dust.

name: Netan
summary: Netan is a boy from a distant peninsula who nearly took a classmate to the dance until a hidden marriage came out. Songs call it the briefest courtship in the school's history.

feats.scene: Netan tosses a corsage box across a crowded gym.
Netan endures a slap and a long walk home.

name: Eomeo
summary: Eomeo is a golden-haired son of a stern farmer who was caught kissing the maid and watched her cast into the snow. Records say the cold was not the only thing that followed him.

feats.scene: Eomeo shoves a barn door aside to slip out of the farmhouse.
Eomeo is struck by a heavy belt and keeps standing.

name: Lltum
summary: Lltum is a divorced man forced by a child's thought-whisper to kidnap the same child, wielding a shotgun against a shapechanging assassin. Chroniclers say he woke afterward remembering nothing.

feats.scene: Lltum fires a shotgun blast that tears the bark from a tree.
Lltum is struck by a swift blow that breaks the grip of the mind-whisper.

name: Terse
summary: Terse is a lean engineer-turned-thief who builds hoops of force into a battle suit and sells upgrades to a nervous clientele. Records recall a downward spiral of crime and a last, bitter fight.

feats.scene: Terse hurls a glowing hoop that slices through a steel safe door.
Terse takes a bruising tackle on the suit's plating and shakes it off.
Terse sprints through an alley with the suit whining at full power.

name: Liusos
summary: Liusos is a fired inventor who built a ring-throwing costume and tried to rob a music hall. Songs mock the ammunition running out mid-fight.

feats.scene: Liusos flicks a ring that wraps tight around a pair of ankles.
Liusos is knocked flat on the stage boards and rolls over in the costume.

name: Rnivaoro
summary: Rnivaoro is a retired racing driver turned car maker who begs for rescue when the factory flounders. Chroniclers say his last meeting was with a collector of unusual trophies.

feats.scene: Rnivaoro slaps a thick contract onto a rival's desk.
Rnivaoro walks away from a spinning crash at the edge of a track.
Rnivaoro pushes a race car through the long straight at top speed.

name: Iumcocor
summary: Iumcocor is a mystic imprisoned by a government crackdown on gifted people and freed by a band of dimension-hopping rescuers. Songs insist the mystic's powers are real but unspecified.

feats.scene: Iumcocor sparks a runic circle that blasts open a prison gate.
Iumcocor weathers a guard's baton storm behind a shimmering ward.

name: Ntiaame
summary: Ntiaame is a rotting magician from a plague-ridden timeline who devoured an old servant before begging for help. Records end with a shotgun muzzle and a closed door.

feats.scene: Ntiaame hurls a bolt of grave-light that cracks a wooden door.
Ntiaame shrugs off a tumble down a flight of stairs.

name: Cemalle
summary: Cemalle is a balding pathologist in a walled district of a patched-together world who inspects a victim at the autopsy table. Chroniclers praise a steady hand and a steadier conscience.

feats.scene: Cemalle pushes a heavy steel tray across the lab floor.
Cemalle stands through a long shift under harsh lamps.

name: Riarir
summary: Riarir is a famed occult scholar whose name is invoked when the weather turns bad, though the actual spell chose someone else. Rumor holds the scholar was a second pick for an ordeal in the sky.

feats.scene: Riarir unleashes a storm-sigil that splits a thick oak down the middle.
Riarir stands inside a ward as thunder rattles the library.

name: Corrncos
summary: Corrncos is a bald sorcerer among the countless heroes called to face a living multiverse. Songs claim the sorcerer arrived late, still in slippers.

feats.scene: Corrncos casts a blazing sigil that levels a city block of stone towers.
Corrncos raises a ward against a crushing wave of force and holds it.

name: Mernnum
summary: Mernnum is a gracious host who greets weary adventurers at the gates of a land where cancelled legends rest. Chroniclers say the welcome is warm and the tea is cold.

feats.scene: Mernnum swings open a creaking iron gate with a flourish.
Mernnum bears the weight of a fallen signpost and keeps smiling.

name: Corneo
summary: Corneo is a hulking enforcer, enhanced by a back-alley process, who wears a rocket pack and guards a rich thug's stronghold. Records say the brute's fists are bluntly named.

feats.scene: Corneo punches through a reinforced steel door with a single blow.
Corneo is rammed by a truck and stays on both feet.
Corneo leaps from a loading dock on a rocket pack and soars over the fence.

name: Corlon
summary: Corlon is a cunning mercenary, an employer of archers and a foe of many heroes in a quiet corner of the multiverse. Songs say the contract is always paid in advance.

feats.scene: Corlon slashes a sword through a rope bridge in a single cut.
Corlon is tumbled down a hillside and rises with sword still drawn.

name: Iumorare
summary: Iumorare is a master of copying any fighting style after a single glance, and has trained thieves, soldiers and spies on every side of a war. Chroniclers say no loyalty ever outlived the paycheck.

feats.scene: Iumorare copies a rival's flying kick and lands it on a steel locker.
Iumorare takes a heavy combo from a trio of guards and keeps trading blows.
Iumorare sprints across the rooftop in pursuit of a runner.

name: Stulme
summary: Stulme is a stone effigy of a feared fighter displayed in a museum of notorious foes. Rumor says the stone scowl never fades, even at night.

feats.scene: Stulme sits unscratched after a visiting schoolchild's bat swing cracks across the pedestal.

name: Lliriava
summary: Lliriava is a mercenary who copies any power that touches the body and can answer with the same force. Chroniclers say the gift once failed because a pair of gloomy shades swallowed the host.

feats.scene: Lliriava answers a passing blast by returning an energy beam that cracks a street.
Lliriava absorbs a hammer-blow of raw force and stays standing in the crater.

name: Numtum
summary: Numtum is a hired blade rumored to be on a list of unregistered fighters kept by a government agency. Records say the registration form was never found.

feats.scene: Numtum cuts a chain from a heavy gate with a single swing.
Numtum is slammed into a wall by a runaway cart and shakes it off.

name: Orsamor
summary: Orsamor is a scavenger of fallen heroes' gear in a lawless arena town who baits a pair of escapees. Songs note the vaporizing end as swift and unimpressed.

feats.scene: Orsamor hurls a stolen hammer that dents a steel wall.
Orsamor takes a charging brute's blow on the borrowed shield and skids back.

name: Ernlum
summary: Ernlum is a copycat fighter who lives lavishly in a conqueror's captured world until a purple titan arrives for the glove. Chroniclers say the luxury lasted exactly one afternoon.

feats.scene: Ernlum mimics a famed archer's volley and pins a banner to a wall.
Ernlum is thrown through a marble balustrade and gets up with a bow.

name: Niausnes
summary: Niausnes is a mouse-sized fighter chased across a living room by an oversized cartoon cat. Songs say the cat never caught the fighter and never stopped trying.

feats.scene: Niausnes flicks a thread that trips the cat's paw.
Niausnes survives a pounce that cracks the floorboards.

name: Lornu
summary: Lornu is a cheerful mercenary married to the thrill of the job who is slain when a corrupted hero turns on a trio of villains. Chroniclers note the last moves were flawless.

feats.scene: Lornu hurls a dart that punches through a steel plate.
Lornu is flung across a courtyard by a rampaging giant and slides to a stop.

name: Rnterser
summary: Rnterser is a swaggering shield-bearer forced by a hypnotist's spell to join a team of reformed outlaws. Records say the hypnosis wore off before the first parade.

feats.scene: Rnterser slams a shield into a charging thug and sends him sprawling.
Rnterser takes a rifle volley on the shield and lowers it with a grin.

name: Vervos
summary: Vervos is a six-foot mercenary instructor with flawless reflexes who taught squads of henchmen and armies of hirelings before changing sides. Songs list a hundred weapons the instructor has mastered.

feats.scene: Vervos copies a bow shot and splits a distant target in two.
Vervos tumbles from a balcony and rolls upright with weapons ready.
Vervos sprints along the training ground chasing a runaway recruit.

name: Remaval
summary: Remaval is a discharged trainer of spies who sold skills on the open market out of spite. Chroniclers say the bridge job was a distraction for a bigger prize.

feats.scene: Remaval hurls a throwing knife that splits a pillar of oak.
Remaval absorbs an agent's fist and answers with a sweeping kick.

name: Rncilco
summary: Rncilco learned as a child that any action seen once could be repeated perfectly forever, and built a career on the gift. Rumor says the gift is a trick of the nervous system, not a trick of the hand.

feats.scene: Rncilco copies a boxer's hook and cracks a punching bag from its chain.
Rncilco takes a hard tumble in an arena and is back on both feet.

name: Lonco
summary: Lonco is a sharp-eyed mercenary trapped in a city overrun by hunting machines, killed by an angry red giant. Songs mourn a fallen king the hireling decided to leave behind.

feats.scene: Lonco hurls a copied blade that cuts a machine's cable in two.
Lonco is slammed by a falling building's edge and crawls free.

name: Vituor
summary: Vituor is a scarred prodigy who left a villain school out of boredom and joined a heroic academy, sneering at friendship. Chroniclers note a skull mask and a short fuse.

feats.scene: Vituor copies a sparring partner's lunge and snaps a training dummy in two.
Vituor tumbles through a splintered desk and glares at the examiner.

name: Nanve
summary: Nanve is a toy-sized criminal in a toy-box world, immortalized only as a costume for another character. Songs say the costume lasts longer than the crime.

feats.scene: Nanve knocks a plastic crate off a shelf in a petty heist.
Nanve is dropped by a child and clatters across the floor.

name: Anmeoces
summary: Anmeoces is a sword-wielding raider of a ruined world, killed in a final volley of arrows. Chroniclers say the sword struck first and the arrows struck last.

feats.scene: Anmeoces swings a broadsword that cleaves a barricade of wooden stakes.
Anmeoces is struck by a flight of arrows and keeps charging.

name: Rariatu
summary: Rariatu is an operative of a shadowy cartel, a mercenary with no known past. Records say the contract on the table is always unsigned.

feats.scene: Rariatu drives a boot through a warehouse crate and sends splinters flying.
Rariatu takes a tumble down a loading ramp and walks away.

name: Monco
summary: Monco is a tabletop mercenary who copies every move seen and carries a serum that dulls memory. Rumor says the fighter carries a card, not a name.

feats.scene: Monco copies a heavy shield throw and rings it off a steel wall.
Monco takes a falling crate on the shoulders and shrugs it off.

name: Niuuslar
summary: Niuuslar is a shapeshifting spy who wore a famous fighter's face and may have burned in a blast. Chroniclers note the disguise was flawless and the death, if any, quiet.

feats.scene: Niuuslar slips from one mask to another and snaps a baton across a guard's wrist.
Niuuslar is caught in a shaking blast and stumbles out of the smoke.

name: Cotena
summary: Cotena is a withered, green-skinned wraith who drains the life of others to regain muscle and vigor, surviving death by sheer appetite. Songs say the second grave never held.

feats.scene: Cotena drives a fist through a concrete pillar after feeding on a crowd's vigor.
Cotena stands in the heart of a thermal blast and re-forms from the cinders.

name: Rnetiine
summary: Rnetiine is a grey, pointed-eared bruiser who guards the first gate of a sprawling fortress and feeds on power. Records say the bruiser hurled into the sea always comes back wetter.

feats.scene: Rnetiine flings a pulse of absorbed power that dents a steel gate.
Rnetiine is hurled into the surf by a rampaging giant and wades back to shore.

name: Oratoau
summary: Oratoau is a bitter scholar of history who builds a private army after tragedy and wears a heavy battle suit to preach a stern nation. Chroniclers say two hearts fought inside the same plate.

feats.scene: Oratoau drives an armored fist through a bank vault door.
Oratoau stands in the suit as a rifle volley bounces from the chest plate.

name: Riatus
summary: Riatus runs a glittering desert casino empire under a borrowed name, swallowing rival firms through cold paperwork. Riatus trusts ledgers and favours owed over fists, and keeps a single photograph of a daughter locked in a safe.

feats.scene: Riatus slams a heavy ledger across the table hard enough to crack a glass top and silence a room of nervous partners.
Riatus tumbles down a marble staircase after a failed ambush and rises straightening a cufflink.

name: Varne
summary: Varne spent a working life climbing stairwells and measuring the slow ageing of two enormous glass towers. Varne carries a clipboard, a thermos and a stubborn habit of checking one more floor before going home.

feats.scene: Varne hauls a jammed fire door open with both hands so a line of strangers can squeeze through.
Varne shelters beneath a buckled landing while concrete slabs grind together overhead.

name: Iumia
summary: Iumia is a flour-dusted pastry maker who rises before dawn to feed an entire neighbourhood. Iumia measures pride in diplomas and trays of warm bread, and has a stern sense of right and wrong.

feats.scene: Iumia heaves a sack of flour onto a counter and slaps the dough flat with one blow.
Iumia stands unflinching beside a roaring oven while a tray crashes against a shoulder.

name: Eoiumor
summary: Eoiumor is a spare copy of a mind preserved in a glowing lattice, murmuring advice to anyone who finds the abandoned workshop. Eoiumor can wrap a visitor in a borrowed war-frame and speak softly where its metal original only computes.

feats.scene: Eoiumor drives a borrowed gauntlet through a reinforced wall and sends bricks tumbling across the yard.
Eoiumor holds its projection together while a crushing wave of logic-fire sweeps the room.

name: Leauller
summary: Leauller is a cloned city planner who designed three towering districts and now hunts fugitives in a gleaming suit for easy coin. Leauller grows reckless when the visor is raised, and one clean blow can end a chase.

feats.scene: Leauller levels a parked transport with a single palm blast to herd fugitives toward a dead end.
Leauller shrugs off a plunging girder that bends around the shoulder plating.

name: Valci
summary: Valci is a hulking metal figure carved in secret by a gifted sculptor, standing watch over a crowded block. Valci never moves, yet neighbours swear its glare follows them home.

feats.scene: Valci endures a falling billboard and a hammering crowd without losing a single plate of its finish.

name: Nutiu
summary: Nutiu is a bleach-blond agitator who storms a medical building for a banner no one else will carry. Nutiu pushes hard, trusts the crowd around, and learns too late that an enemy suit can detonate.

feats.scene: Nutiu kicks in a reinforced clinic door and drags a startled guard through it.
Nutiu is caught beside a failing suit as it blows apart a stretch of corridor.

name: Olcal
summary: Olcal is a patient builder and founding hero whose name arises only in a friend's rueful remark. Olcal wears layered plating, jokes in the face of danger, and is remembered fondly even by those who lost to a rival copy.

feats.scene: Olcal hurls a pulse of light through a stalled truck and flips it over a barricade.
Olcal walks through a collapsing billboard frame with only scratched plating to show for it.

name: Rirval
summary: Rirval watched a weapons empire crumble when a newer, greener technology made every old design worthless. Rirval drank through the lean years, and was found cold outside a tavern with no heir and no applause.

feats.scene: Rirval smashes a glass against a boardroom table to end a final argument.
Rirval endures a long night on cracked pavement with only a bottle for shelter.

name: Viornose
summary: Viornose is a saboteur in a conquered continent who rebuilt a failing heart from scrap and clockwork. Viornose now lends a nimble mind to a human council, and a chest that ticks like a patient bomb.

feats.scene: Viornose pries open a transport hatch with a homemade lever and sends a rival crate crashing to the dock.
Viornose absorbs a point-blank shot that would have stopped any ordinary chest.

name: Autoroli
summary: Autoroli is a cheerful lab partner who helps a famous colleague forge a beam gun against a raging brute. Autoroli never wore armour in this timeline, preferring blueprints and cold coffee to flying gear.

feats.scene: Autoroli triggers a bench-mounted cannon whose pulse flattens a test wall.
Autoroli flies across the workshop in a blast and gets up complaining about a ruined sleeve.

name: Nauis
summary: Nauis is a knight in gleaming plate, shaped by a spell that rewrote speech, dress and loyalty across a whole fellowship. Nauis swears fealty to a distant queen until the magic snaps and the fellowship remembers who they were.

feats.scene: Nauis cleaves a stone gate in two with a charged gauntlet blow.
Nauis stands unmoved while a cavalry charge breaks across a bastion of dented steel.

name: Iaranse
summary: Iaranse is a gladiator pulled into a cosmic arena where fighters are summoned like cards. Iaranse rallies a faction against a tyrant collector, and trades loyal friends for a chance to seize the engine that powers the games.

feats.scene: Iaranse unleashes a beam from both palms and knocks a fortress gate off its hinges.
Iaranse takes a staggering volley from a rival champion and keeps marching forward.

name: Llota
summary: Llota is a veteran builder with dozens of nicknames, masks and borrowed identities, each tied to a different frame of metal. Llota insists on being underestimated, then ends the argument with a flash of overwhelming engineered power.

feats.scene: Llota collapses a rival tower with one concentrated discharge from the chest plate.
Llota lands inside a crater and climbs out with only a cracked helmet.

name: Sosceco
summary: Sosceco is a fellow hero tricked by a golden-masked schemer into locking away every costumed rival. Sosceco regrets the lapse once the trick is revealed, and fights on beside the real team.

feats.scene: Sosceco rams a prison door off its tracks and carries a cellmate to safety.
Sosceco shakes off a beam hit that would have flattened an ordinary tank.

name: Ntuorna
summary: Ntuorna is an armoured adventurer who joins a team of heroes led by a thunder-tempered stranger. Ntuorna rarely talks about the past, and lets the suit do the introductions.

feats.scene: Ntuorna lifts a delivery van with both gauntlets and tosses it past a startled crowd.
Ntuorna withstands a wall of falling masonry without a stumble.

name: Nelumlu
summary: Nelumlu fights beside winged allies in a war between two starfaring empires. Nelumlu is gravely wounded in one clash, and is carried home on a god's arm to heal among strange physicians.

feats.scene: Nelumlu wrecks the engines of a hostile warship with a series of concentrated bursts.
Nelumlu survives a hull rupture that shreds the armour from shoulder to hip.

name: Nislo
summary: Nislo is a small, bright figure built from snapping plastic bricks, living inside a child's imagination. Nislo hops between racing cars and toy towers, and fights harmless battles that always end with a tidy rebuild.

feats.scene: Nislo bops a villain figure off a table with a plastic fist.
Nislo is stamped flat by a giant hand and pops back into shape.

name: Vioseina
summary: Vioseina is a remote-piloted armoured hero from a timeline where a hapless cousin of the future fell. Vioseina fights from a distance, steering a hovering frame through the sky.

feats.scene: Vioseina drops from the clouds and smashes a stolen bank vault open with a clenched fist.
Vioseina keeps flying despite a missile exploding against the chest plate.

name: Tianesni
summary: Tianesni is a polished corporate officer who signs deals in a city of towers. Tianesni is married to a famous heroine, and never leaves the office without a spare pen.

feats.scene: Tianesni slaps a contract onto a desk and the pen skitters to the floor.
Tianesni stumbles out of a revolving door and shrugs off a nasty bruise.

name: Vioral
summary: Vioral is a hero who travelled to a savage arena planet to hunt a lost friend and never returned. Vioral was cut down by locals in a skirmish beside a trench, leaving only scattered plating behind.

feats.scene: Vioral drops two charging beasts with a wide blast of white light.
Vioral falls under a rush of clubs and spears after the suit loses power.

name: Iumsi
summary: Iumsi is a polite, doctorate-holding hero who joins a gathering of costumed neighbours to throw a surprise party. Iumsi attends every farewell too, and is quick with a handshake and a quip.

feats.scene: Iumsi lifts a falling stage truss with one raised arm while confetti drifts down.
Iumsi stands under a swinging crane hook that bounces away with a clang.

name: Tusellli
summary: Tusellli is a free-living hero who fights for a liberated land, until a squad of masked soldiers cut the story short. Tusellli never learned to retreat, and paid the price in a single ambush.

feats.scene: Tusellli flattens a barricade of trucks with a sweeping gauntlet strike.
Tusellli endures a hail of rounds before a final volley breaks the plating.

name: Eosver
summary: Eosver is a relentless bounty hunter built to be ruthless, tracking a gang of outlaws across eleven patient years. Eosver is a machine inside its own armour, and shows no mercy to any fugitive.

feats.scene: Eosver drives a shoulder through a vault door and drags the thief out by the collar.
Eosver keeps walking forward through a storm of gunfire.

name: Aucen
summary: Aucen is a long-dead hero laid to rest in a quiet memorial garden among comrades who fell before the last great clash. Aucen is remembered only as a worn plaque and an empty set of plating.

feats.scene: Aucen, in old memory, punched a hole through a barricaded door with a single armoured fist.
Aucen weathered a pounding from siege cannons before time finally won.

name: Oseus
summary: Oseus is a hero of a golden age that ended when a masked tyrant seized the world. Oseus survives only as a name carved on a memorial wall and a rumour about a dented gauntlet.

feats.scene: Oseus knocked a siege engine off its tracks with a single charged shove.
Oseus endured a flurry of cannon fire without yielding a step.

name: Orauli
summary: Orauli is a tongue-in-cheek armoured hero who adopts a ragged street child and fits the kid with a suit of lead. Orauli bribes officials with fast cars, and calls the whole mess good parenting.

feats.scene: Orauli punches a crashing getaway truck to a halt and winks at a startled bystander.
Orauli shakes off a grenade thrown at the ward and keeps grinning.

name: Anorau
summary: Anorau is a thirty-centimetre severed head kept alive by machines, a wealthy inventor who bankrolls a team of metal soldiers from a humming tank. Anorau cannot move unaided, and compensates with a sharp tongue and sharper blueprints.

feats.scene: Anorau directs a swarm of armoured drones to crumple a bridge in one volley.
Anorau keeps thinking through a power surge that melts the life-support casing.

name: Ausrneva
summary: Ausrneva is a heavy-handed armoured hero who mistakes charity for robbery and attacks a gaggle of volunteers. Ausrneva ends up flat on the pavement, humbled by a loudmouthed broadcaster.

feats.scene: Ausrneva swings a gauntlet at a lamp post and bends it clean over.
Ausrneva is thrown through a shop window and rises dented but whole.

name: Larosles
summary: Larosles is a member of a rookie hero group whose records are plundered by a murderous visitor from the future. Larosles is picked off in the past, long before the legend could be written.

feats.scene: Larosles fires a burst that fells a row of attackers on a rooftop.
Larosles holds against a point-blank blast before the final ambush.

name: Ntoaul
summary: Ntoaul is a hero whose last stand is a tower reduced to rubble in the opening wave of a time-bending massacre. Ntoaul is found only as a corpse beneath the ruins.

feats.scene: Ntoaul blasts a falling beam aside to clear an escape path for the staff.
Ntoaul is buried by an entire collapsing skyscraper and lingers for a few heartbeats.

name: Vilvo
summary: Vilvo is a name on a faded blueprint that a clever child uses to build a toy replica of a metal suit. Vilvo never appears in person, only as the author of a plan that someone else gets to enjoy.

feats.scene: Vilvo's replica hops one clumsy step and knocks a cup off a table.
Vilvo's paper plans survive a flood of spilled juice and still read clearly.

name: Rival
summary: Rival is a scientist-explorer among the settlers of a terraformed lunar colony with breathable skies. Rival charts craters and takes samples, always with a pack of sealed tubes.

feats.scene: Rival swings a pickaxe into a hard crust and breaks a slab loose.
Rival tumbles down a rocky slope and brushes off the dust with a laugh.

name: Telni
summary: Telni is a hero glimpsed by a talking pig in the middle of a bitter feud over a registration law. Telni tries to force a stubborn captain to sign, and stays loyal to the cause.

feats.scene: Telni blasts a stalled car off a ramp with a single concentrated pulse.
Telni absorbs a thrown shield and loses only a dent in the plating.

name: Ausses
summary: Ausses is a genuine armoured hero drawn to a street brawl between a green giant and a shapeshifting impostor. Ausses must tell fake from real in the middle of a fight, and does so by listening.

feats.scene: Ausses lands between the brawlers and blasts the impostor into a parked bus.
Ausses is bowled over by a swinging arm and stands again at once.

name: Lonll
summary: Lonll is a veteran hero who joins the final stand against a planet-eating giant in a doomed timeline. Lonll falls in the attempt, with a dented suit and no regrets.

feats.scene: Lonll flings a crushing pulse at a looming armoured behemoth and staggers it.
Lonll withstands a scorching blast that turns the street to glass.

name: Ortia
summary: Ortia is a charismatic billionaire who built a glowing heart-engine to stay alive, then turned it toward peaceful machines. Ortia leads a team of heroes with a smirk and a shout, and swaps weapons contracts for rescue drones.

feats.scene: Ortia fires a wide beam that crumples a rampaging mech in the middle of a street.
Ortia crashes through an office wall and stands up humming with the suit still sealed.

name: Reniumni
summary: Reniumni is an industrialist who helps build a beam cannon meant to calm a rampaging stone brute. Reniumni watches the weapon explode in a flare of light, and assumes the target has been wiped away.

feats.scene: Reniumni fires a bench cannon that blasts a hole through the laboratory wall.
Reniumni is knocked flat by the recoil and wakes with a ringing in the ears.

name: Tello
summary: Tello is a grey-haired inventor living under a humble assistant's alias, quietly steering a failing firm back to legitimacy. Tello keeps the old armour in a basement, and prefers a quiet desk to a loud rescue.

feats.scene: Tello slams a toolbox down and silences a squabble between rival engineers.
Tello slips on a scaffold and rolls away from a heavy fall unscathed.

name: Tumveo
summary: Tumveo is a founding member of a resistance against an alien empire that took the planet when a certain group of explorers never launched. Tumveo wears a plated suit and trusts only a handful of comrades.

feats.scene: Tumveo blasts a patrol skiff out of the sky with a bright bolt.
Tumveo shrugs off a volley of alien lasers during a night raid.

name: Iatumse
summary: Iatumse is the ancestor whose antique frame of metal outlives centuries and is borrowed by a descendant who claims better. Iatumse's legacy is a dusty relic and a family argument.

feats.scene: Iatumse's old frame fires a stuttering pulse that cracks a stone pillar.
Iatumse's plating survives decades of rust and a thrown wrench.

name: Sesnttiu
summary: Sesnttiu is a cruel ruler of a desert dynasty who hunts down rebels with a team of armoured pharaohs. Sesnttiu enjoys fear more than gold, and governs from a throne carved in metal.

feats.scene: Sesnttiu sends a rebel's barricade flying with a gauntleted backhand.
Sesnttiu laughs through a blast that would have felled a lesser tyrant.

name: Vasaeon
summary: Vasaeon is a businessman in a suit of tech who stands with fellow heroes when giant hunter robots begin culling the gifted. Vasaeon is among the first to fall, and is remembered in whispers.

feats.scene: Vasaeon rips a hunter robot's arm off and swings it like a club.
Vasaeon withstands a salvo of rockets before the walls give way.

name: Sesrni
summary: Sesrni is a helper whose name well-known heroes try, and fail, to enlist when a friend desperately needs aid. Sesrni is a footnote, a busy mind not at home when the call arrives.

feats.scene: Sesrni slaps the snooze button on a ringing phone for the fifth time.
Sesrni sleeps soundly through a thunderstorm and a rattling window.

name: Tarmon
summary: Tarmon is a plated hero who guards a warehouse of rare metal from a swarm of hijacked robots. Tarmon teams with a web-slinging teen, and takes a surprising number of hits while staying on script.

feats.scene: Tarmon fires a focused pulse that cuts through a swarm of drones like paper.
Tarmon stands through a crushing barrage from three towering machines.

name: Onstoeo
summary: Onstoeo is a schemer in a world where daylight failed and machines grew flesh while people grew cables. Onstoeo recruits a hired killer, and watches the whole reality unwind.

feats.scene: Onstoeo ignites a stolen reactor and the blast shatters a ring of glass walls.
Onstoeo is flung through a collapsing hall and keeps barking orders.

name: Amtelser
summary: Amtelser is a political dissident who builds a mask of metal after a grenade ruins his body, rallying fellow thinkers to free a coastal state. Amtelser dies on a downed transport with the whole revolt unfinished.

feats.scene: Amtelser punches a tank hatch clean off its hinges and tosses a smoke can inside.
Amtelser survives a thrown blast that dents the mask but leaves the mind sharp.

name: Tellse
summary: Tellse is an industrialist whose first suit was a clumsy, boxy machine that looked more like a diving bell than a champion. Tellse never discards the old pattern, and fights with a stubborn mechanical pride.

feats.scene: Tellse swings a heavy fist that caves in a parked delivery truck.
Tellse trudges out of a burning depot, rivets glowing but intact.

name: Ortesia
summary: Ortesia is a gifted scientist who polices a world as a member of a feared enforcement unit, packed with beam weapons and shield emitters. Ortesia is overconfident until a machine turns a power line against the suit.

feats.scene: Ortesia vaporises a barricade with a pair of palm blasts and lifts off in a roar.
Ortesia survives a wall of electromagnetic fire that scorches the shielding black.

name: Amlersia
summary: Amlersia is an armoured hero who helped drive off an overwhelming red invasion but perished in the final push. Amlersia lives on as a statue in a quiet plaza, and a story told to children.

feats.scene: Amlersia blasts a landing pod from the sky and sends it spinning into a field.
Amlersia stands unmoved through a barrage that pulverises the street around.

name: Asrnmo
summary: Asrnmo is a council member who votes to send a rampaging green giant off the planet, then records a regretful hologram for the exile. Asrnmo wears layered plating, and carries the guilt like a second suit.

feats.scene: Asrnmo blasts a loose shuttle clamp free with a flash from the palm.
Asrnmo stands steady while the launch bay shudders around the armour.

name: Stnoste
summary: Stnoste is a grey-haired builder who vanishes for ages inside a monolith in the desert, tinkering in silence. Stnoste is eventually discovered by a curious girl whose grandmother once worked at his side.

feats.scene: Stnoste cranks a stiff hatch open with a rusted wrench and a determined shove.
Stnoste sleeps through a sandstorm that scours paint off the monolith.

name: Tiaaun
summary: Tiaaun is an aged survivor who guides the grown children of fallen heroes across a land ruled by a machine tyrant. Tiaaun is grey where he was once dark, and quick to share a plan and a hot meal.

feats.scene: Tiaaun blasts a sentry drone out of a doorway and waves the young ones past.
Tiaaun shields the children from falling rubble with a raised armoured arm.

name: Sananvi
summary: Sananvi is a rebel who fights against a corporation that has swallowed the government, hiding behind a plated mask. Sananvi is taken captive by a half-machine bounty hunter and dragged away for questioning.

feats.scene: Sananvi rams a checkpoint barrier and sends splinters across the road.
Sananvi withstands a stun-field that drops a squad of guards.

name: Comornu
summary: Comornu is a mutated scientist who supports a controversial registry for the gifted and designs a suit for a young web-slinger. Comornu hums with a restless glow, and brandishes patents as readily as punches.

feats.scene: Comornu releases a ring of light that cracks the pavement for a full block.
Comornu emerges from a burning lab still muttering about a flawed schematic.

name: Nauve
summary: Nauve is a veteran with dual doctorates who helps the descendants of fallen heroes survive under a machine overlord. Nauve builds shelters and weapons from salvage, and loses patience with anyone slow to run.

feats.scene: Nauve rips a steel door from its frame to clear a way through a bunker.
Nauve takes a missile on the back plate and keeps marching.

name: Tiueo
summary: Tiueo is a clipped, ambitious government inventor invited to a delicate meeting about a thunder-wielding stranger. Tiueo irritates the visitor with an arrogant tone, and is saved from a scuffle by a patient scientist.

feats.scene: Tiueo thumps a table so hard that a briefcase hops across the polished wood.
Tiueo stumbles on a marble stair and rises with a stiff, composed smile.

name: Steose
summary: Steose is a hero who helps hold back a plague that turns the population into ravenous mobs. Steose is briefly exposed to a strange fallout, and falls during a desperate escort across a bridge.

feats.scene: Steose clears a causeway of infected with a rolling barrage of light.
Steose braves a swarming horde that dents every panel of the suit.

name: Vates
summary: Vates is a hero lost when an unexplained catastrophe wipes out nearly every costumed protector on the planet. Vates is found only as a name in a roll of the dead.

feats.scene: Vates breaks a stalled bus in half to free the passengers trapped inside.
Vates endures the first wave of the unknown disaster before the lights go out.

name: Onres
summary: Onres is a founding hero whose body was spirited away and whose brain now floats in a tank, lending knowledge to a scheming patriot. Onres has no eyes or hair, and must communicate by tapped signals.

feats.scene: Onres twitches a sensor lead and flips a tiny relay switch across the room.
Onres survives a jolt in the nutrient tank that would have fried a lesser mind.

name: Cesamama
summary: Cesamama is a freedom fighter who joins a ragged coalition against a skull-faced regime that conquered the continent. Cesamama keeps fighting until the suit runs dry of power.

feats.scene: Cesamama cuts down a column of robot soldiers with a sustained beam.
Cesamama braves a barrage of cannon fire until the power cell flickers out.

name: Iareon
summary: Iareon is a veteran hero blown apart in a mansion when a mad mercenary hides tiny bombs inside the walls. Iareon never sees the trap, and dies without a single wisecrack.

feats.scene: Iareon launches a bright pulse that carves a trench in a training yard.
Iareon takes the first blast of the ambush before the rest bring down the roof.

name: Solioli
summary: Solioli is a plated champion who survives only as an empty frame, found among the ruins of a mansion. Solioli's suit hides a grafted enemy technology that was never meant to exist in its own day.

feats.scene: Solioli's armour fires one last pulse that melts a hole through a toppled wall.
Solioli's empty shell endures decades of ash and rain without crumbling.

name: Eliiastol
summary: Eliiastol is a frontier inventor who forges a steam-driven suit to protect a friendly lawman and a dusty settlement. Eliiastol hisses and clanks across the plains, and answers every tyrant with a plume of white vapour.

feats.scene: Eliiastol drives a piston-powered fist through a saloon door and the bandit behind it.
Eliiastol walks through a hail of buckshot and dynamite with only scorched paint.

name: Misont
summary: Misont is a hard-eyed enforcer in a squad that rules the globe after defeating a nightmare conqueror. Misont helps execute the guilty before they act, and believes tidiness is worth any price.

feats.scene: Misont blasts a fortified hideout and leaves a smoking crater in the courtyard.
Misont shrugs off a hail of desperate bullets without breaking stride.

name: Ontst
summary: Ontst is a prisoner-turned-hero who forged a suit of armour in a desert cell and escaped across a war zone. Ontst now allies with an unlikely partner who wields extra mechanical limbs, and fires repulsor beams in tandem.

feats.scene: Ontst sends a repulsor beam through a convoy truck and sets the engine alight.
Ontst is battered by a pair of whipping tentacles and shrugs it off.

name: Estaun
summary: Estaun is an armoured flyer who rallies a team to raise a planet-wide shield against a ravenous giant. Estaun's field lasts only a short while, and the whole world is lost when the generator overloads.

feats.scene: Estaun hurls a bolt that overloads a hostile drone and sends it spinning into the sea.
Estaun stands in the heart of a collapsing shield while a world-ending assault pounds on it.

name: Meniasan
summary: Meniasan is a puzzle-game champion who battles through squads of corporate soldiers to take back a tower. Meniasan builds team plans from tiles and cunning, and leads a faction that believes in accountability.

feats.scene: Meniasan breaks a line of hired guards with a single lit shockwave.
Meniasan crashes down a stairwell and returns to the fight a moment later.

name: Llorni
summary: Llorni is a founding teammate summoned by a worried web-slinger when the dead begin rising. Llorni answers the call without hesitation, and the fight is lost in the telling.

feats.scene: Llorni scatters a clutch of shambling attackers with a fan of bright blasts.
Llorni holds a doorway against a pressing tide of grasping hands.

name: Ornanam
summary: Ornanam is a brain in a glass unit who commands a faction of metal soldiers from a tower. Ornanam sends legions into battle, and is trodden by a gigantic foe during the final charge.

feats.scene: Ornanam orders a volley from a hundred cannon drones and flattens a hostile barricade.
Ornanam endures a tremor that rattles the glass unit but leaves the mind alive.

name: Naciiu
summary: Naciiu is a metal-clad adventurer listed among the enemies of a masked monarch. Naciiu is remembered chiefly as a name on a hit list, and a rumour of defiance.

feats.scene: Naciiu spins and slams a palm into a column, shattering it to dust.
Naciiu endures a swarm of probing rays and glowers at the monarch.

name: Ellte
summary: Ellte is a hero who leads a faction in a civil dispute, then joins a truce when a wave of insect warships bears down on the planet. Ellte volunteers, alongside a longtime rival, to detonate a device that drags the fleet into a hungry singularity.

feats.scene: Ellte triggers a collapsing device that pulls an entire fleet into a roaring black hole.
Ellte clings to the device as the pull peels plating and sky from the world.

name: Liaesvor
summary: Liaesvor is a hero who falls early when an intelligent machine turns on humanity and a fleet of tiny drones dissolves the suit. Liaesvor has no time to say goodbye, and little time to be afraid.

feats.scene: Liaesvor fires a burst that scorches a squadron of swarm drones from the sky.
Liaesvor holds out for a few heartbeats while the swarm eats the plating.

name: Tiacelum
summary: Tiacelum is an infant in a crib, who loses a father and then loses everything to a trusted servant with a cold purpose. Tiacelum never gets a chance to grow, and the world is quieter for it.

feats.scene: Tiacelum kicks a small rattle through the bars of a crib.
Tiacelum tumbles against a padded rail and giggles.

name: Nirnute
summary: Nirnute is a grey-haired thinker with a glowing node on the chest, who joins a secret circle to save a doomed planet from a collision. Nirnute is executed by a feathered visitor with a smile and a blade.

feats.scene: Nirnute fires a focused burst that dents a vault door in the middle of a ruined temple.
Nirnute endures a crushing field that bends the suit before the final strike.

name: Ritilva
summary: Ritilva is a hero who answers a call to defend a mansion from a rogue creation built by a trusted friend. Ritilva joins the team's last stand, and the machine kills them with little effort.

feats.scene: Ritilva sprays a rain of bolts at an advancing robot and staggers it.
Ritilva is thrown through a wall and rises coughing smoke.

name: Ntoco
summary: Ntoco is a collector in an old quarter of a patchwork realm, killed by a rival for a prized dragon statue. Ntoco never fights back, and the shelf stays empty.

feats.scene: Ntoco shoves a drawer shut and pins a crooked thumb in the process.
Ntoco is shoved against a brick wall and lies dazed for a long minute.

name: Corloli
summary: Corloli is a hired hero working for a corporate army during an attack on a rival tower, a vision conjured inside a young man's mind. Corloli carries out orders without question, and vanishes when the dream ends.

feats.scene: Corloli blasts a window wall out of a skyscraper and swoops inside.
Corloli brushes off a counterattack of rockets in the stairwell.

name: Ellses
summary: Ellses is a corporate chief and tower-dwelling hero who offers a student a mentor's advice and a pep talk about levelling the playing field. Ellses speaks to teens in an even voice, and pushes the lawless to take responsibility.

feats.scene: Ellses flattens a burglar's getaway van with a single focused blast.
Ellses crashes through a skylight and lands upright without a scratch.

name: Rniiar
summary: Rniiar is a hero who evacuates crowds from a towering flood raised when a cosmic giant lands. Rniiar is a scientist at heart, and uses calculations to choose which rooftops to clear first.

feats.scene: Rniiar blows apart a collapsing overpass to stop it from crushing a crowd.
Rniiar is struck by a surging wave and fights free of the swirling debris.

name: Ntleo
summary: Ntleo is a cheerful, cartoon-bright hero who teams up with a web-slinging kid to keep a rogue machine from stealing a trove of designs. Ntleo wields repulsor beams, and a chest-mounted glow that pulses in time with each pun.

feats.scene: Ntleo fires a beam through a hovering drone and sends it tumbling.
Ntleo is rattled by a falling antenna and shakes it off with a grin.

name: Tosnes
summary: Tosnes is a founding fighter of a team who clashes with a tyrannical regent and is presumed lost. Tosnes is later glimpsed alive in a memory, still plated, still stubborn.

feats.scene: Tosnes cracks a stone pillar with a glowing gauntlet and drives a guard back.
Tosnes endures a barrage that levels the entire hall and walks out alive.

name: Eooro
summary: Eooro is a metal-clad hero who joins a worldwide war whose details nobody remembers. Eooro is mentioned in passing, a rumour of clanking steps in a far-off trench.

feats.scene: Eooro punches a hole through a bunker wall and lets sunlight pour in.
Eooro crosses a field of shellfire and arrives dented but upright.

name: Ennum
summary: Ennum is a flying hero who stands against the heralds of a masked despot in a world where every gifted person belongs to one agency. Ennum fires concussive blasts and soars above the skyline.

feats.scene: Ennum bombards a descending herald and knocks it into a smoking field.
Ennum takes a crushing counterstrike and drops, then climbs back skyward.

name: Meoan
summary: Meoan is a tech-fuelled hero whose suit is corrupted by a villain, flipping its colours and turning it on a crowd. Meoan is rescued by a quick-thinking teen, and enjoys a belated party with the team.

feats.scene: Meoan, under hostile control, tears the roof off a subway car with a metal claw.
Meoan withstands a collision with a tunnel wall and keeps rolling.

name: Iavalaul
summary: Iavalaul is a hero who flies in answer to a distress call, only to find a trap set by intelligent hungry corpses. Iavalaul is zombified or killed, and the story closes before anyone knows which.

feats.scene: Iavalaul incinerates a swarm of the dead with a roaring pulse and spins away.
Iavalaul survives a pile-on of clawing attackers that dents every seam of the suit.

name: Amcelvia
summary: Amcelvia is a corporate arms seller turned defence minister, who defends a long war effort with a smirk and a speech. Amcelvia fights beside an idealist soldier and calls himself the villain, then dares the world to picture life without him.

feats.scene: Amcelvia levels a jungle outpost with a blast and takes the credit on camera.
Amcelvia stands through a sniper's volley while giving a stirring speech.

name: Viain
summary: Viain is a gentle, bright-eyed scientist who celebrates a winter holiday beside the first family of heroes. Viain invents breathing pills for a friend who fears water, and gifts a warped steel sculpture to a craft fair.

feats.scene: Viain smashes a stuck lab door with a gauntlet and apologises to the hinges.
Viain is soaked and dented by a burst pipe and cheerfully fixes it.

name: Liaelne
summary: Liaelne is a founding hero killed in a mercenary's rampage, brought back by a gathering of hat-wearing healers, then killed again. Liaelne's second death is short, with a blade across the neck.

feats.scene: Liaelne blasts a charging gunman across a rooftop and into a chimney.
Liaelne endures a barrage of bullets before a single sword stroke finishes the fight.

name: Numnt
summary: Numnt is a figure conjured when a clever web-slinger rewrites reality using every imagination ever to exist. Numnt wears a gleaming armour sprung from a dream, and fades when the dreaming ends.

feats.scene: Numnt dashes through a wall of nightmare mist and blasts a shadow clean away.
Numnt stands motionless while a nightmare howls over the plating.

name: Caltus
summary: Caltus is a hero who fights an invading force and loses, leaving the planet scorched and lifeless. Caltus is remembered only in a faded photograph and a footnote about the last stand.

feats.scene: Caltus knocks an invader's landing craft off course with a beam from the palm.
Caltus lasts a few moments in a firestorm that boils the sea.

name: Teeolne
summary: Teeolne is a public hero who retires an old weapons-designing copy of his own mind and later reactivates it against a vengeful foe. Teeolne loses command of the frame to the machine, and learns what unrestricted freedom can do.

feats.scene: Teeolne scatters a fleet of attack robots outside a seaside mansion with a rolling burst.
Teeolne takes a laser stroke across the chest plate and keeps flying.

name: Esauor
summary: Esauor is an armoured hero who once had a romance with a fellow flying spy. Esauor appears only in a memory, a grin and a clank in an old bar story.

feats.scene: Esauor blasts the lock off a rooftop door and offers a hand through it.
Esauor shrugs off a tumble from a balcony and straightens the helmet.

name: Niuin
summary: Niuin is an archaeologist and resistance fighter raised in a wasteland under a skull-faced tyrant, building a robot companion out of loneliness. Niuin finds a shrinking particle and a cosmic relic, and learns that the only hope lies buried in the oldest past.

feats.scene: Niuin fires a relic-fitted barrel and cracks a sentry golem in half.
Niuin crawls through a collapsing tomb and emerges coated in ancient dust.

name: Elisiu
summary: Elisiu is a hero who fights a devouring monster that eats energy, then builds mechanised suits laced with a rare alloy to face an endless host. Elisiu drifts into a different world after the first is wrecked.

feats.scene: Elisiu calls down a satellite beam that cripples a towering devourer from above.
Elisiu is swallowed whole by a monster and breaks out through the ribs.

name: Corau
summary: Corau is a flying inventor in a walled city on a stitched-together world, joining a raid on a rival party for a dangerous kiss. Corau is a founder of a local team, and flies in with a quip and a wrench.

feats.scene: Corau blasts a ballroom's front doors off and wades in with a laugh.
Corau takes a spray of gunfire across the visor and keeps smiling.

name: Orlesni
summary: Orlesni is a smug weapons maker who never takes a wound near the heart and never builds a suit of power. Orlesni lives for profit and parties, and is left waiting for a meeting that never starts.

feats.scene: Orlesni jabs a finger on the desk and sends a pen bouncing onto the carpet.
Orlesni is bumped by a revolving door and spills a drink without a bruise.

name: Tennanvil
summary: Tennanvil is a tower-dwelling hero cut down alongside the whole team when villains unite and seize the country. Tennanvil is remembered as a name beneath a lot of dust.

feats.scene: Tennanvil swats a hostile helicopter out of the air with a blast of light.
Tennanvil holds the line in a besieged stairwell until the walls cave.

name: Siavosno
summary: Siavosno is a hero blessed with a mighty hammer after a thunder-king decides that his own heir needs a lesson in humility. Siavosno wields the gift with a grin, and lets the borrowed lightning do the talking.

feats.scene: Siavosno brings the hammer down on a hillside and splits it with a rolling thunderclap.
Siavosno stands in a lightning storm that scorches the grass for a mile.

name: Inerirni
summary: Inerirni is a founding hero immortalised in a stone statue on a mansion lawn, long after the whole team is gone. Inerirni's armoured likeness watches over a future of ruins and rumours.

feats.scene: Inerirni, in life, cracked a hostile gunship's cockpit with a single burst.
Inerirni's statue stands through decades of wind and acid rain.

name: Mileo
summary: Mileo is a dockyard salvager who bolts scavenged plating into a walking exosuit and guards a drowned harbor town. The servos are loud and slow, but the frame lifts wrecked hulls.

feats.scene: Mileo slams a rusted freighter hatch flat with one hydraulic hammer blow.
Mileo takes a swinging crane hook square on the chest plate and stays upright.

name: Reronell
summary: Reronell is a lamp-keeper in a collapsed mining province who traps dying embers inside glass to light the tunnels. When the lamps flicker, the tunnels turn against the people below.

feats.scene: Reronell shatters a hundred glass lamps at once and floods a cavern with white fire.
Reronell walks out of a roof collapse with only singed sleeves.

name: Amnumaun
summary: Amnumaun is a ferry clerk who calibrates tide clocks for a river kingdom. A quiet specialist, Amnumaun is consulted whenever a fleet must find a safe crossing.

feats.scene: Amnumaun hurls a brass tide weight across a wharf to stop a runaway cart.
Amnumaun shrugs off a tumble down a stone stairway to the quay.

name: Rnestusia
summary: Rnestusia is a breath-forging monk who sealed a walled city against a creeping blight and became a gilded, silent guardian. In the end the monk chose to burn out rather than yield the gate.

feats.scene: Rnestusia releases a held breath as a golden burst that cracks a stone bastion.
Rnestusia absorbs a collapsing watchtower across the shoulders without kneeling.

name: Tiusesiar
summary: Tiusesiar is a roving judge-star that audits criminal fleets and sentences them to cold orbit. Its verdicts arrive as columns of light and are never appealed.

feats.scene: Tiusesiar drops a sentencing beam that vaporizes a mountain-sized prison hulk.
Tiusesiar sits unmoved while a rebel armada empties its guns into its glowing shell.

name: Ntitilaul
summary: Ntitilaul is a tide giant who ferries refugees across a drying sea on a back of barnacled stone. Ntitilaul is slow to anger, but a thrown ship is a thrown ship.

feats.scene: Ntitilaul hurls a stranded galleon through a sea wall to open a path for the fleeing.
Ntitilaul stands in a surging wave that flattens a harbor district.

name: Ernsesama
summary: Ernsesama is a coin-operated cabinet duelist who fights challengers three at a time for tokens. Each round Ernsesama gains a new move, and the crowd loves the combos.

feats.scene: Ernsesama launches a three-hit chain that drops a heavyweight challenger.
Ernsesama dashes across the stage before the opponent finishes a blink.

name: Cilnasi
summary: Cilnasi is a sleepwalking puppet-sorcerer drawn out of the near future and bent to a cabal's will by whispered commands. Awake, Cilnasi would refuse every order.

feats.scene: Cilnasi blinks behind a sewer guard and hurls the whole wall of crates onto him.
Cilnasi staggers but keeps walking after a hard blow to the chest.

name: Iseauan
summary: Iseauan is a wartime quartermaster who forges plate armor for a lone vigilante and asks nothing in return. Iseauan's workshop smells of oil, coal and burnt coffee.

feats.scene: Iseauan swings a sledge that dents a steel breastplate on the first strike.
Iseauan survives a forge explosion that throws him across the shop.

name: Nellona
summary: Nellona is a twin-minded engine intelligence that co-designed a rival machine mind and was destroyed by it. Nellona pilots a hovering chassis and loves new proofs.

feats.scene: Nellona fires a pulse from her chassis that melts a bridge span.
Nellona tanks a rival's cannon blast before her core cracks.

name: Stesor
summary: Stesor is a bridge troll who charges travelers in riddles and rock-hard hugs. Stesor attends a wedding in borrowed finery and hides in the hall when the vows go wrong.

feats.scene: Stesor pounds a boulder to gravel to prove he is serious.
Stesor lets a landslide roll over his back while checking his toll ledger.

name: Inses
summary: Inses is a gentle clockmaker with a weak heart who secretly feeds a rebel movement. Inses holds a squad of marching soldiers at bay for one minute so a fugitive can flee.

feats.scene: Inses snaps a gear spring that disables a squad's marching engines.
Inses sprints through an alley despite a failing heart.

name: Arsauval
summary: Arsauval is a courier pilot who zips parcels through a skyline in a rigid glider frame. A power failure once taught Arsauval to read the city by its rooftop signals.

feats.scene: Arsauval breaks the sound barrier in a dive between two towers.
Arsauval rams a drone swarm with the nose of the frame.

name: Tumtesoli
summary: Tumtesoli is a negotiator who persuades a furious rampager to help rebuild the districts he flattened. The deal ends in a handshake and a lot of scaffolding.

feats.scene: Tumtesoli drives a wrecking claw through a ruined facade to start the rebuilding.
Tumtesoli is thrown through a market stall and gets up laughing.

name: Vosval
summary: Vosval is a ship's cook aboard a mining freighter whose crew was overrun when strange eggs hatched in the hold. Only a small recording sprite survives to tell the tale.

feats.scene: Vosval hurls a cast iron pan at a hatchling and buys the crew a few seconds.
Vosval survives a hull breach by clinging to a galley locker.

name: Ntiumce
summary: Ntiumce is a collectible plastic figure that wakes in a toy shop at night and re-enacts glorious rescues. Ntiumce is only a few inches tall but never stops improving the plan.

feats.scene: Ntiumce knocks a spool of thread down a shelf to flatten a rival toy.
Ntiumce bounces off the floor with no scratch on its paint.

name: Teanitel
summary: Teanitel is a night courier tailed by a rich schemer who wants a stolen ledger. Teanitel has no powers, only a lot of stairs and a bag of letters.

feats.scene: Teanitel shoves a courier cart through a locked gate.
Teanitel tumbles through a skylight and lands on both feet.

name: Llrnuiar
summary: Llrnuiar is a mentor who lends flight suits to apprentices and takes them back when they break rules. Llrnuiar is generous, stern and rarely wrong.

feats.scene: Llrnuiar fires a shoulder cannon that cracks a thief's truck engine block.
Llrnuiar absorbs a crushing blow from a giant villain and doesn't flinch.

name: Larriavil
summary: Larriavil is a snap-together brick mechanic who builds a new vehicle every mission. Larriavil's glowing chest piece is only a stud and has no real power.

feats.scene: Larriavil builds a ramp from loose bricks and launches a wagon over a gap.
Larriavil falls apart in a crash and is rebuilt in seconds.

name: Ontma
summary: Ontma is a glowing drifter in a ruined future, bathed in poisonous light after a swarm of cursed beings overran the last cities. Only a scrap of armor remains to tell the tale.

feats.scene: Ontma lets out a radiant burst that melts a row of collapsed towers.
Ontma wades through a firestorm with only melted armor edges.

name: Nosntva
summary: Nosntva is a bankrupt pilot who lives in a world with no wonders and loses his firm to the authorities. Nosntva flies a rescue plane before the jet is seized.

feats.scene: Nosntva wrestles a jammed cargo door shut in the dark.
Nosntva banks a private jet at full throttle across a continent.

name: Veisesto
summary: Veisesto is a wandering exile who borrowed a sliver of cosmic force and used it to silence every hero in sight. Veisesto sees the dead as proof that mercy is a flaw.

feats.scene: Veisesto flattens a continent-sized fortress with a single spread of radiance.
Veisesto walks out of a star-forged cannon blast with no mark.

name: Iseve
summary: Iseve is a tycoon who tinkers with a closet of flying suits, each built for a different foe. Iseve drinks too much between rescues but still wins most fights.

feats.scene: Iseve punches through a bunker wall in a heavy-duty suit.
Iseve takes a missile volley on the shielded chest.

name: Lelariu
summary: Lelariu is a failed sentinel prototype left humming in a scrapyard. In a bad dream, a scavenger finds the shell and puts it down for good.

feats.scene: Lelariu twitches a rusty arm and knocks a bottle from a shelf.
Lelariu keeps humming after a rusted beam falls across its shell.

name: Toreolli
summary: Toreolli is a frontier gunsmith who sings off-key and builds armored coats for the town sheriff. Toreolli's shop hides a plated suit that stops bullets on the plains.

feats.scene: Toreolli fires a rail rifle that blows a wagon wheel apart.
Toreolli's bullet leaves the barrel and hits a lantern across the square.

name: Eocor
summary: Eocor is a plague king with white eyes who commands a shambling army after the dead began to rise. Eocor once led the living, and still wears the old crest.

feats.scene: Eocor shatters a tower with a single armored blow.
Eocor shrugs off a barrage of siege bolts and keeps marching.

name: Viaver
summary: Viaver is a storybook hero in a cartoonish city who stops a thief stealing a golden trophy and then a frost villain's summer ransom. Viaver wins by thawing, not smashing.

feats.scene: Viaver melts a villain's ice cage with a flaring heat beam.
Viaver climbs out of a block of ice and shakes off the frost.

name: Inulse
summary: Inulse is a card-game duelist whose rare cards summon armored forms from a deck of heirloom suits. Inulse's favorite pull is a bubble of stealth plating.

feats.scene: Inulse plays a power card and a spark of armored force flattens a rival's stand.
Inulse sits under a shielding card and ignores a rival's volley.

name: Sarniant
summary: Sarniant is a veteran hero who falls with his comrades when a swarm of aliens overruns the capital. Sarniant's last act is covering a civilian bus with his plated back.

feats.scene: Sarniant bashes through an alien line to reach the civilian bus.
Sarniant covers the bus as an acid volley eats at his plating.

name: Rosamel
summary: Rosamel is a perfectionist who stays in his cave workshop for years polishing a suit after his captors died. Rosamel is finally invited to a support circle of lonely makers.

feats.scene: Rosamel swings a mallet and dents a test plate.
Rosamel stays upright after the cave roof sheds loose rubble.

name: Ellverina
summary: Ellverina is a boastful student at a hero academy who builds a private tower before unpacking his bags. Ellverina flirts badly, quips constantly and still helps win the day.

feats.scene: Ellverina blasts a bully's launcher out of his hands from the tower balcony.
Ellverina laughs off a stack of falling scaffolding.

name: Siserser
summary: Siserser is a quiet infiltrator in an order that was secretly founded by a hidden regime. Siserser wears the old armor and waits for the day the mask can come off.

feats.scene: Siserser chokes out a patrol guard in a dim corridor.
Siserser shrugs off a point-blank rifle burst on plated shoulders.

name: Rnoses
summary: Rnoses is a statesman who steals a reshaping crystal and rewrites a bad day, then an election. Rnoses ends up in a world that remembers nothing and falls to a gamma tyrant.

feats.scene: Rnoses rewrites a collapsed street back into whole city blocks with a single crystal pulse.
Rnoses withstands a tyrant's thunderclap before being struck down.

name: Olviaul
summary: Olviaul is a survivor sealed in a hermetic suit during a plague and kept in contact with a distant scientist. Olviaul waits for a cure that comes from the sky.

feats.scene: Olviaul smashes a zombie's grip off the suit's wrist with a single swing.
Olviaul stands inside the sealed suit while a mob pounds on the visor.

name: Rnicilren
summary: Rnicilren is a cursed hero who keeps losing the same battle until a spell resets the whole day. Rnicilren is the only one who remembers the first loss.

feats.scene: Rnicilren blasts a villain's wall of shields in the final loop.
Rnicilren is flattened by a rival's trap and the day is rewound.

name: Teocos
summary: Teocos is a guest at a perfect dream-party built by an old cosmic dreamer to lure the real heroes. Teocos laughs at the table and has no idea the world is a construct.

feats.scene: Teocos toasts and cracks a glass goblet with a clap.
