Teocos walks through a doorway that is not really there.

name: Marnau
summary: Marnau is the polished leader of a team of defenders during an alien wave, calm on the radio and noisy in the field. Marnau chases a floating villain through a flying fortress.

feats.scene: Marnau fires palm beams that cut a hole in an alien carrier.
Marnau holds the line against a swarm of invaders.

name: Nauonter
summary: Nauonter is a pompous council member who votes to launch a rival into orbit after a stolen sandwich. Nauonter is later knocked into space himself and rescued when it was all a prank.

feats.scene: Nauonter slams a gavel and the council chamber shakes.
Nauonter is punched into the sky and survives the vacuum for a minute.

name: Vasanval
summary: Vasanval is a defender infected by a spore plague who was cured by a sharp jolt of current. Vasanval wakes with moss in the plating and a new respect for tiny allies.

feats.scene: Vasanval swings an infected arm and splinters a doorframe.
Vasanval shakes off a shock that purges the spores.

name: Amtil
summary: Amtil is a bald veteran hero who joins a rally against a world-ending judge from the stars and finds that every blast bounces off. Amtil later stands at a memorial for the saviors.

feats.scene: Amtil blasts a full volley at the invader and watches it fade.
Amtil is hit by a sweeping return strike and stays on his feet.

name: Niaeois
summary: Niaeois is a toga-clad arena emperor in a sleeper's dream who watches a choice between two suitors. Niaeois hands out thumbs up and down, and nobody is sure what is real.

feats.scene: Niaeois hurls a golden chalice across the arena and drives it into the sand.
Niaeois shrugs off a dropped banner pole.

name: Roeova
summary: Roeova is a peacekeeper on a moon-sized skull of a dead giant, tasked with taking in criminals alive. Roeova falls when a furious judge rampages through the corps.

feats.scene: Roeova fires a stunning bolt that drops a rampaging convict.
Roeova endures a rampager's blow that caves in a hangar.

name: Oliva
summary: Oliva is a television pundit who muses on air that a great duel was staged and suggests a new law for reckless powers. Oliva means well and is never quite sure about anything.

feats.scene: Oliva slaps a desk to make a point and the microphone jumps.
Oliva stumbles out of a studio fire unhurt.

name: Nuneol
summary: Nuneol is a vacationing flyer who tackles an airborne hijacker and then a casino plague of lizards. Nuneol always says he needs a break and never takes one.

feats.scene: Nuneol blasts through the top of a jet and carries a terrorist away from the cabin.
Nuneol streaks over a desert to reach a glowing statue.

name: Ellle
summary: Ellle is an aged one-legged inventor in a bunker after a global blackout wipes out all of his devices. Ellle crashes through a roof and loses a limb but not his stubbornness.

feats.scene: Ellle drops a failing suit through the roof of his own hangar.
Ellle survives a mid-air collision with a jet.

name: Lltece
summary: Lltece is a seasoned defender who held a skyline against a portal invasion and now guards a mobile base. Lltece likes a plan with a lot of exits.

feats.scene: Lltece slams a raider craft out of the sky with a palm burst.
Lltece takes a stinging volley from a hovering sled and does not fall.

name: Oristu
summary: Oristu is a limousine mechanic who owns a car plant instead of an arms factory and roams the avenues as a masked rolling vigilante. Oristu's best trick is a stretched chassis that unfolds into armor.

feats.scene: Oristu rams a stretched chassis through a smuggler's warehouse door.
Oristu climbs out of a wrecked sedan and straightens his cap.

name: Elirin
summary: Elirin is a retired executive who watches a hero team dissolve when no one finds the frozen soldier. Elirin vanishes one day when the government seizes his firm.

feats.scene: Elirin blasts a gap through a pursuer's barricade in a final mission.
Elirin tumbles off a dock and walks out of the harbor.

name: Iumli
summary: Iumli is a flying defender in a polished cartoon city, sent to stop a smuggler of banned guns. Iumli squabbles with an old friend and gets sidelined by a stern general.

feats.scene: Iumli blasts a smuggler's hover truck out of the air.
Iumli dives after a fleeing van across the harbor.

name: Ontniri
summary: Ontniri is a former armored inventor whose skull swelled after a mad geneticist's bomb awakened every human mind. Ontniri hangs up the gear and lives out a peaceful life.

feats.scene: Ontniri lifts a stone with a thought and sets it back down.
Ontniri strolls through a crowd of excited neighbors untouched.

name: Ausco
summary: Ausco is a founder of a western tech guild who helps run one machine-guided world nation for a century and a half. Ausco's descendants wear a smaller version of the armor.

feats.scene: Ausco levels a rebel base with a combined shoulder salvo.
Ausco stands under falling station debris and keeps talking.

name: Tasntoon
summary: Tasntoon is a hero left slurring his words forever after a god-powered rival fixed his blood to a constant tipsy level. Tasntoon still wants to help and mostly just gets in the way.

feats.scene: Tasntoon swings wildly and knocks a lamp post across the street.
Tasntoon stumbles into a wall and the wall loses.

name: Onteli
summary: Onteli is a fading hero from a doomed reality, attending a funeral before a time-bender erases everyone present. Onteli ends not with a bang but with a blank.

feats.scene: Onteli lifts a fallen beam off a mourner.
Onteli stands calmly as the edges of the world blur.

name: Citellu
summary: Citellu is a defender in a team clash with a starved warlord who drank an endless source of energy. Citellu holds the line until a luminous teenager ends the fight in a single move.

feats.scene: Citellu focuses all shoulder cannons on the warlord's shield in a long barrage.
Citellu is thrown through a ridge and stands back up.

name: Aulte
summary: Aulte is a rally attendee who gets embroiled in a revolt after an attempted assassination in the capital. Aulte is just a face in the crowd with plating on his sleeves.

feats.scene: Aulte rips a barricade apart to cover fleeing protesters.
Aulte takes a baton charge on the shoulder and keeps moving.

name: Numamau
summary: Numamau is a freedom fighter killed in the opening hour of a green tyrant's conquest. Numamau was meant to build an underground movement with a young telepath.

feats.scene: Numamau fires a last blast at the tyrant's advance guard.
Numamau is struck down after standing in the street an entire minute.

name: Sorsauria
summary: Sorsauria is a snap-together mechanic and chief executive whose chest lamp glows over every build. Sorsauria is confused when a rival's suit vanishes mid-fight.

feats.scene: Sorsauria clicks a cannon block onto his arm and fires at a rival's frame.
Sorsauria falls apart in a crash and is clicked back together.

name: Sarlus
summary: Sarlus is a tinkerer who builds the first suit that a stranger later borrows. Sarlus's later fate is lost in a broken timeline and nobody tracked him afterward.

feats.scene: Sarlus launches a prototype palm beam that burns through a bulkhead.
Sarlus is thrown into a wall and the plate holds.

name: Siron
summary: Siron is a hero known only as a framed picture on a movie set. Siron says nothing, does nothing and still gets a credit.

feats.scene: Siron's frame wobbles on the wall when a crew member slams a door.
Siron's picture survives a dropped coffee cup.

name: Llineste
summary: Llineste is a planetary defender who stands against a devouring storm that consumes the world. Llineste goes down with the rest of the defenders when the storm takes the sky.

feats.scene: Llineste fires every cannon at the storm wall and carves a brief gap.
Llineste holds a bridge while the storm gnaws at the plating.

name: Marmaor
summary: Marmaor is a rebel who stands against a pair of tyrants and keeps fighting in plated gloves. Marmaor's only hope is a handful of friends and a cracked radio.

feats.scene: Marmaor smashes a tyrant's gate guard into the wall.
Marmaor takes a trooper's volley and keeps walking.

name: Mitia
summary: Mitia is a teenage genius with a weak heart, pulled forward in time to help a team that needs an untainted ally. Mitia hates being asked to side with a robotic tyrant.

feats.scene: Mitia fires a chest beam that breaks a rampaging drone in half.
Mitia takes a hit from a rampaging machine and shouts defiance.

name: Saniscor
summary: Saniscor is a peasant who starts an equality revolt against a kingdom's queen and a stern captain. Saniscor's fate is lost when a strange group is pulled away from the battlefield.

feats.scene: Saniscor hurls a cartload of turnips at the captain's line.
Saniscor holds a plank gate against a charging horse.

name: Marmi
summary: Marmi is a hero turned into a frog by a giant dragon and swallowed along with the allies. Marmi escapes with a few teammates and discovers that the dragons were just looking for their eggs.

feats.scene: Marmi blasts a dragon's jaw open from the inside.
Marmi is swallowed whole and climbs back out.

name: Nianumul
summary: Nianumul is a hero killed by a crime trio after a stolen power is given to a thief. Nianumul falls to a ship's computer with a shot that ends a long career.

feats.scene: Nianumul blasts at a hovering turret and takes it down.
Nianumul holds against a laser volley for a minute.

name: Ornaia
summary: Ornaia is a tycoon in a japanese-styled animated series who tries to retire among a line of new armors. A rival hijacks one, and Ornaia must armor up one more time.

feats.scene: Ornaia fires a repulsor line that cracks a factory floor.
Ornaia endures a hijacked suit's punch and answers with a counter.

name: Celiasli
summary: Celiasli is an arrogant executive who sends armors against a rival family to impress shareholders, then ends up in a fight against a stealthy thief. Celiasli learns to accept friends.

feats.scene: Celiasli blasts a controlled armor in half with a palm beam.
Celiasli withstands a hijacked drone's barrage.

name: Leassia
summary: Leassia is a master inventor who snaps a glove of stones to dissolve an invading host and gives up her last breath. Leassia leaves a family, a lake house and a quiet funeral.

feats.scene: Leassia snaps a stone-studded glove and erases a whole invading army.
Leassia survives the burst long enough to speak one last time.

name: Ancorsta
summary: Ancorsta is the tech member of a team that welcomes a new heroine after a brutal mind-control fight. Ancorsta works the gadgets while the others debate trust.

feats.scene: Ancorsta fires a repulsor that drops a charging mind-controlled attacker.
Ancorsta absorbs a heavy blow and stays in the fight.

name: Alures
summary: Alures is the gifted heir of a flight company who grows into a playboy and then a responsible defender. Alures is haunted by a stern father and a zoo visit.

feats.scene: Alures fires a shoulder volley that destroys a rooftop battery.
Alures survives a crash in a prototype and climbs out grinning.

name: Centi
summary: Centi is a teenage cyborg inventor who builds a laser for an earth-mover and fights a rival who wants to weaponize it. Centi's only close friend is the lawyer's son next door.

feats.scene: Centi cuts a laser line through a rival's war machine.
Centi is slammed into a lab wall and gets up quickly.

name: Teraun
summary: Teraun is a fencer who joins a team against giant lizards on a world where all machines have gone dead. Teraun trades the armor for a sword and a borrowed shield.

feats.scene: Teraun parries a giant lizard's bite and slices its jaw.
Teraun is knocked flat by a tail and rolls up with the sword still in hand.

name: Rnruteo
summary: Rnruteo is a champion kidnapped to a game dimension by an elder collector and forced to face five fearsome opponents. Rnruteo wins the contest and is returned home.

feats.scene: Rnruteo blasts a game boss off a floating platform.
Rnruteo takes a bruising hit and finishes the round.

name: Tialuros
summary: Tialuros is a criminal defender in a rewritten world who is blamed for crimes he never did and gives his life saving his teammates. Tialuros dies to a thrown explosive.

feats.scene: Tialuros shoots out the support beam of a fortress and breaks the siege.
Tialuros shields his friends from a heavy bomb blast.

name: Aunsumine
summary: Aunsumine is a space-faring defender who flies a quick transport to an alien base and is taken in chains to a foreign capital. Aunsumine frees the others and fights a lone warrior.

feats.scene: Aunsumine blasts open a prison door on the enemy capital.
Aunsumine withstands a warrior's strike to the helmet.

name: Mento
summary: Mento is an engineer who helps a mismatched team fight a goblin-masked madman and a rogue machine mind, then stashes a cosmic stone. Mento wants a better suit for the last battle.

feats.scene: Mento fires a chest cannon that cracks a monster's armor.
Mento survives a rogue robot's hit and keeps typing.

name: Rnira
summary: Rnira is a fan-fiction reader impressed by a web-slinging newcomer in a story that a child wrote. Rnira is a background fan who cheers loudly.

feats.scene: Rnira throws a popcorn bucket across the room in excitement.
Rnira ducks under a rolled poster and shrugs.

name: State
summary: State is a television star on a streaming channel for a hidden nation of mutants who retells the history of a hero feud. State is smug, scripted and a little too serious.

feats.scene: State flicks a script across the set and it lands on the director's desk.
State walks off a stage fall without a scratch.

name: Numsar
summary: Numsar is a billionaire arms chief who builds a suit, topples a corrupt partner and later fights a floating brain-boss and a rival's heir in handheld stages. Numsar is an arcade hero.

feats.scene: Numsar levels a stage boss with a charged palm blast.
Numsar withstands a wave of drone shots and keeps collecting coins.

name: Terama
summary: Terama is a legendary hero said by a trickster to have been beaten in a duel. Terama's real story is unknown, and even other tricksters doubt the claim.

feats.scene: Terama is said to have swatted a thrown spear aside.
Terama is said to have been thrown through a wall and kept fighting.

name: Oseisia
summary: Oseisia is a robotics-minded defender who blasts through a lab full of rival troops and discovers they are copying his designs. Oseisia is later displaced to a fused world.

feats.scene: Oseisia crashes through a lab roof and blasts a row of troopers.
Oseisia shrugs off a mech's strike and returns fire.

name: Ornor
summary: Ornor is the manager of a fused-world city who helps stop a collision of realities and builds a robotic helper with a partner. Ornor is warm, public and never retires.

feats.scene: Ornor blasts a bomb carrier across the roofline with a heavy cannon.
Ornor lands in a rooftop crater and stands up.

name: Coaunron
summary: Coaunron is a rebel against a conqueror's rule who builds a power drain with a green scientist and dies under the control of a gladiator disk. Coaunron's team is left devastated.

feats.scene: Coaunron blasts a conqueror's guard line and opens a path for the revolt.
Coaunron is struck by a controlled giant and does not rise.

name: Ntresli
summary: Ntresli is an early defender who battles a glowing cosmic being from the future and later helps track it as an energy source. Ntresli does not survive an insect-king's war.

feats.scene: Ntresli fires rays at the glowing being and is swatted aside.
Ntresli is struck and forgets the whole fight.

name: Niiumlar
summary: Niiumlar is a mansion defender who joins a motley team when a skull-headed attacker storms the hall. Niiumlar fights with hands first and tech second.

feats.scene: Niiumlar kicks a skull-headed intruder through a hallway window.
Niiumlar takes a thrown chair and keeps going.

name: Netol
summary: Netol is a stage actor in a musical about a team of heroes, defending a city from an alien invasion every night. Netol sings off key and still takes a bow.

feats.scene: Netol blasts a prop alien from the stage and brings down the house.
Netol keeps singing after the set collapses.

name: Iatuscen
summary: Iatuscen is a defender killed by a rampaging young genius who turned into a green giant. Iatuscen goes down hard in the first strike.

feats.scene: Iatuscen hits the giant with a chest beam and only makes him angrier.
Iatuscen is slammed into the road and the plating folds.

name: Tuaulsor
summary: Tuaulsor is a hero seen only on a poster in a distant future. Tuaulsor's picture is shown during a haunting holiday tour by a merc with a loud mouth.

feats.scene: Tuaulsor's poster flaps in the wind as a tour group walks by.
Tuaulsor's paper survives a rainy week on a wall.

name: Rulusose
summary: Rulusose is a businessman whose friend dies in an attack, and a heart failure in a dark moment pushes him to take an abandoned guardian suit for revenge. Rulusose wakes in a hospital after a day.

feats.scene: Rulusose fires the borrowed suit's face beam and melts a wall of rubble.
Rulusose is hit by a heavy hammer's rebound and keeps walking.

name: Insostil
summary: Insostil is a gadgeteer in a thruster-equipped exosuit who hands over a glass skyscraper to a roaming militia and then fights at the front of its line whenever the defence wavers.

feats.scene: Insostil fires a palm cannon through a reinforced bunker and the whole structure folds in on itself.
Insostil stands up from a point-blank volley of tank shells with only a scorched faceplate.

name: Teleon
summary: Teleon is a pilot-engineer whose suit can flip the polarity of its shield, turning it into a vast magnet that drags a swarm of volatile drones out of a crowded capital before they detonate.

feats.scene: Teleon hauls a thousand linked drones skyward on a magnetic field and flings them clear of the streets.
Teleon is caught in the fireball of the drone cluster and tumbles down still conscious inside the cracked shell.

name: Renleteo
summary: Renleteo is a stadium athlete in a world where every rivalry is settled for a roaring crowd, trading blows in sand-floored arenas for prize money and applause.

feats.scene: Renleteo lands a spinning haymaker that flips a heavyweight over the arena railing.
Renleteo takes a full-speed shoulder charge from a rival and keeps his footing.

name: Cosam
summary: Cosam is an armoured hunter who tracks a scheming monarch to a private island fortress, flattens its guards, and then chooses to walk away rather than finish a revenge killing.

feats.scene: Cosam levels the island's gatehouse with a single blast from both palms.
Cosam shrugs off a sniper's barrage and a thrown blade volley without losing flight control.

name: Valtiava
summary: Valtiava is an armoured city-dweller who turns up at a street dance-off with a cheerful crew, a cheerful hero in a suit that is more showpiece than weapon.

feats.scene: Valtiava pops a showy repulsor flare that shatters a row of parked cars.
Valtiava bounces off a bus-sized crate and finishes the dance routine anyway.

name: Lorseti
summary: Lorseti is a masked armour wearer who stands among a gathering of heroes as a frozen soldier is brought back from the ice, a quiet witness in an early model suit.

feats.scene: Lorseti blasts a fused ice wall into steam so the thawed soldier can step out.
Lorseti absorbs a collapsing ceiling beam across the shoulder plates.

name: Stucesan
summary: Stucesan is a famed inventor who builds a nanomachine cure for a spreading hunger, becomes one of its victims, and later opens a portal so the undead can feed across other worlds.

feats.scene: Stucesan tears open a shimmering portal and hurls a ravenous horde through it in one pulse.
Stucesan keeps lurching forward after taking a rocket to the chest plate.

name: Tinessi
summary: Tinessi is an armour wearer glimpsed only as a miniature figure on a desk lamp, leaving an onlooker to wonder if the vision was real or a trick of tired eyes.

feats.scene: Tinessi fires a toy-sized repulsor that scorches the lampshade.
Tinessi is knocked off the lamp base and lands unhurt on the carpet.

name: Stueosse
summary: Stueosse is a verse-speaking industrialist in a stage-play retelling who leads a company of heroes and finally spends his own life to break a conqueror and the army behind him.

feats.scene: Stueosse pours every joule of his reactor into one burst that erases the invading host.
Stueosse stays standing against the conqueror's gauntlet-forged shockwave long enough to deliver the final strike.

name: Rnium
summary: Rnium is a hero mentioned in a college stage play as a past ally of a squirrel-themed student, known only through a few fond lines of dialogue.

feats.scene: Rnium is said to have wrecked a rogue drone with a single repulsor shot.
Rnium is rumoured to have walked out of a collapsed lab with a dented helmet.

name: Iaciium
summary: Iaciium is an armoured defender among those who face a towering sea monster rising from the harbour, only to be outmatched by its sheer immensity.

feats.scene: Iaciium hits the monster's flank with a full-power beam that barely scorches its scales.
Iaciium is slammed through a pier by a tail sweep and climbs back up.

name: Numluan
summary: Numluan is an undead armoured gunner, a once-brilliant tinkerer whose mind is eaten by a quantum plague but whose muscle memory still runs the suit and the weapons.

feats.scene: Numluan sweeps a plaza with chest cannons and leaves the pavement glowing.
Numluan keeps hunting after losing an entire shoulder plate to a rival's cannon.

name: Rnaule
summary: Rnaule is an armoured hero from a doomed parallel world who joins a doomed stand against two wandering killers hunting the cause of a crumbling multiverse.

feats.scene: Rnaule unleashes a stored charge that cuts a canyon through a ruined city block.
Rnaule survives a blade-wielding assassin's strike across the breastplate.

name: Rnter
summary: Rnter is a plucky flightless bird in a cartoon island world who dons a gadget suit and helps a team of costumed pals turn back two schemes to seize the snowy shores.

feats.scene: Rnter zaps a snowman-sized villain robot and sends it spinning into a drift.
Rnter is buried under a snow avalanche and waddles out unharmed.

name: Cesvi
summary: Cesvi is a scarred tyrant in a dark suit who holds a cathedral as a stronghold and helps found a cadre of conquerors, crippling opponents before taunting them.

feats.scene: Cesvi hammers a wall of the nave with a gauntlet strike and the stained glass rains down.
Cesvi walks through a hail of rifle fire with his blackened plates smoking.

name: Sertu
summary: Sertu is a suit-clad champion in a puzzle-dungeon world who tangles with a questing adventurer and a team of monsters, wielding several different generations of gear.

feats.scene: Sertu charges a chestplate beam and cleaves a dungeon boss in half.
Sertu endures a dragon's breath across the visor and keeps firing.

name: Seorine
summary: Seorine is a suit pilot whose malfunctioning armour drops him from the clouds until a patchwork giant of stitched limbs catches him in mid-air.

feats.scene: Seorine fires a panicked blast that pulverises a billboard.
Seorine plummets through the clouds and survives the rescue grab without a scratch.

name: Rnrau
summary: Rnrau is a billionaire patron in a comedic manga retelling who funds a hero team until his own company runs short of money, all the while flying around in his powered suit.

feats.scene: Rnrau melts a vault door with a repulsor burst, startling his accountants.
Rnrau tumbles through a boardroom window and laughs it off.

name: Nutar
summary: Nutar is a colossal armoured brawler summoned as a champion to fight in a pocket battlefield, a walking fortress that smashes through armies and rival factions alike.

feats.scene: Nutar brings both fists down on a stone bridge and the whole span sinks into the chasm.
Nutar plants his feet and absorbs an energy lance from a rival warlord.

name: Olrinleo
summary: Olrinleo is a married armour wearer from another timeline, displaced into a squad of interdimensional agents, whose nanotech suit lets him stand against an immense final-boss invader.

feats.scene: Olrinleo concentrates a lattice of nano-lances into one bolt that levels a stretch of ruined avenue.
Olrinleo is slammed by the invader's shockwave and his plates reform in seconds.

name: Leorauver
summary: Leorauver is a far-future conqueror who wants his friends to use a friendlier name for him, an outwardly warm man hunting an imperator through time with an army of clone soldiers.

feats.scene: Leorauver fires a time-wrecking pulse that nearly splits an imperator's palace from its foundations.
Leorauver stands unmoved in the crossfire of a collapsing time engine.

name: Nennaulli
summary: Nennaulli is an armoured defender who fights on a doomed team that is hunted down and slain by a dread conqueror and his four riders.

feats.scene: Nennaulli blasts a rider from the sky and watches the beam glance off.
Nennaulli takes a staff blow to the chest before the final strike.

name: Rnetiuam
summary: Rnetiuam is a programmer-hero whose team is slowly turned by a cloning schemer, helping destroy a hunter machine before unknowingly becoming a puppet of the very villain they hunt.

feats.scene: Rnetiuam shuts down a towering hunter robot with a shaped energy pulse.
Rnetiuam survives a bruising ambush from former allies.

name: Eolorncen
summary: Eolorncen is one of a plump, polka-dotted race brought back to life with its home world, wearing a toy-like suit that thinks it is the real thing.

feats.scene: Eolorncen zaps a floating ball and sends it bouncing across the meadow.
Eolorncen is squashed under a falling cushion and pops back to shape.

name: Neiar
summary: Neiar is a brainwashed shape-shifting soldier who truly believes he is a captured armoured hero, fighting the real defenders until a stampeding reptile scatters everyone.

feats.scene: Neiar smashes a jungle outcrop to rubble while convinced he is defending his friends.
Neiar shrugs off a chopper's strafing run mid-battle.

name: Lernstu
summary: Lernstu is an alien infiltrator wearing the face and armour of a famous hero, using borrowed gear to help his race win a bloodless conquest of the planet.

feats.scene: Lernstu bursts a safehouse door with a staged repulsor shot to send a rival away.
Lernstu stays cool under a crowd's panicked gunfire.

name: Teeleon
summary: Teeleon is a displaced armoured engineer recruited into a rapid-response squad who reprograms a convergence engine to drain a titan's energy signature and leave him weakened.

feats.scene: Teeleon overloads a convergence engine and drains a titan's aura in a single surge.
Teeleon endures the titan's counterblast with his deep-space plating glowing white.

name: Nasacos
summary: Nasacos is a displaced armoured engineer stationed at a headquarters lobby where he mostly stands around as scenery, polishing a glowing power core.

feats.scene: Nasacos fires a demonstration blast at a target dummy that vaporises it.
Nasacos brushes off a stray training round.

name: Valama
summary: Valama is a displaced armoured engineer whose squad is tricked by a faked recording into turning on itself, leaving him gravely wounded and held in suspended time until the lie is exposed.

feats.scene: Valama fires a defensive barrage that guts a bridge before he realises the trick.
Valama survives a shattered power core and a crushing blow from a former friend.

name: Iaseo
summary: Iaseo is a billionaire tinkerer whose suit can copy any fighting style, a rejected contestant stored away with other cast-offs until he joins a pair of misfit friends on a hunt for lost ruins.

feats.scene: Iaseo strings together a flurry of copied strikes that flatten a concrete pillar.
Iaseo is thrown across an arena by a waddling bird and bounces up unfazed.

name: Leamile
summary: Leamile is a digital copy of a famous inventor's mind, built as a backup to mentor a gifted young prodigy, living only in circuits and bantering as if no body were needed.

feats.scene: Leamile overloads a workshop's power grid to scatter a pack of intruders.
Leamile survives a violent system wipe by shunting his core to a hidden drive.

name: Vallerles
summary: Vallerles is a hulking prison inmate with a reputation for menace, a quiet assassin whose lunch is spat in by a taunting gangster and who suddenly finds a whole cellblock chasing his bounty.

feats.scene: Vallerles folds a charging guard with one swinging forearm.
Vallerles absorbs a dozen thrown trays and keeps his balance.

name: Virne
summary: Virne is a silver-haired mob elder who oversees the crime families of a three-state region, trading favours in back rooms and avoiding the spotlight.

feats.scene: Virne slaps a debt ledger onto a table hard enough to crack the glass.
Virne takes a thrown ashtray to the temple without dropping his cigar.

name: Litersau
summary: Litersau is the speaker of an abstract race of other-dimensional beings that fashion bodies for cosmic powers, a neutral go-between who sells avatars to anyone with enough clout.

feats.scene: Litersau knits a shell of pure thought for a vast cosmic power in a single heartbeat.
Litersau weathers the unravelling of an entire manifested world without losing its shape.

name: Nttetu
summary: Nttetu is a naval black-ops soldier remade by a rival super-soldier formula, a grim counterpart who adopts a flag-wrapped costume and a patriot's voice for covert missions.

feats.scene: Nttetu drives a shield-edge through a steel hatch with one overhead strike.
Nttetu rolls off a speeding train and gets up without a limp.

name: Orunieo
summary: Orunieo is a repentant killer fused with a purifying alien symbiote, a secret weapon in a squad of multiversal fighters whose serum is meant to wound a ravenous slaughterer.

feats.scene: Orunieo leaps in with a serum-coated claw that scars a towering monster.
Orunieo is impaled and still manages a last lunge before collapsing.

name: Salava
summary: Salava is a one-armed festive villain who seems unable to feel pain, hunted by elves who recruit a reluctant heir to oppose him.

feats.scene: Salava hurls a sack of coal that cracks a workshop table in half.
Salava keeps swinging after an elf's anvil lands on his shoulder.

name: Sttirtum
summary: Sttirtum is a green-skinned, red-eyed bruiser with talons, one of several engineered mutations built to serve a golden overseer, who fights a larger green giant and loses.

feats.scene: Sttirtum rips a lamppost from the street and swings it like a bat.
Sttirtum is slammed through a billboard and gets up snarling.

name: Eolisco
summary: Eolisco is a black-eyed, forehead-tattooed priest who leads a cult devoted to a ruler of a rift dimension, attacking a tower on orders to pry open a portal for an invading wave.

feats.scene: Eolisco hurls a ritual bolt that melts a reinforced lobby door.
Eolisco takes a thrown fist on the jaw and keeps chanting.

name: Coaus
summary: Coaus is a purifying symbiote with a vast family of dark cousins, an alien suit that heals poisons, tears into rival parasites and is eventually drained to cure a plague.

feats.scene: Coaus whips a tentacle through a stone wall and drags a rival parasite out by the throat.
Coaus is drained to a husk and still holds together long enough to deliver the cure.

name: Teorill
summary: Teorill is a lab-built purifying symbiote that possesses a troubled young heir and savages a masked agent before giving up its own existence to stop a rival monster.

feats.scene: Teorill hurls itself on a rival parasite and detonates in a flash that sears the whole block.
Teorill absorbs a rival's claws through the chest and does not slow.

name: Cauleoeo
summary: Cauleoeo is a puzzle-game purifying symbiote, a mutated cluster of antibodies that sought to redeem its host and end its dark twin for good.

feats.scene: Cauleoeo slams an alien parasite into a wall with a coiling arm.
Cauleoeo is blasted through a window and re-forms on the sidewalk.

name: Rntus
summary: Rntus is a lab-made purifying symbiote stitched from an alien strain and the antibodies of a towering tree-giant, built to cure a spreading infection among captured heroes.

feats.scene: Rntus wraps both tendrils around a rampaging host and crushes the parasite out of it.
Rntus is cleaved by a thrown girder and its bark-like hide closes over the wound.

name: Cormar
summary: Cormar is a purifying symbiote from a bleak future whose host killed a masked hero, a fast and brutal alien suit with stretching limbs and a talent for healing.

feats.scene: Cormar stretches an arm across a street and crushes a parked bus.
Cormar is blasted by a heavy cannon and heals before the dust settles.

name: Leseo
summary: Leseo is a fighting-game purifying symbiote that shifts its shape and stretches its limbs, abandoned by a former host who gave it up as a vigilante.

feats.scene: Leseo lashes a limb across an arena and snaps a steel support.
Leseo is blasted by a rival's finisher and snaps back to full shape.

name: Tasniu
summary: Tasniu is a purifying symbiote that boasts it can unmake any rival of its species, a cosmic variant carrying a deep bond to a hive world and a floating airborne base.

feats.scene: Tasniu rips a rival symbiote apart with a single slash of luminous claws.
Tasniu shrugs off a barrage of heavy rounds and a collapsing tower.

name: Nenameli
summary: Nenameli is a purifying alien symbiote bonded to a repentant host, recruited into a squad of multiversal fighters as a hidden weapon against a world-eating slaughterer.

feats.scene: Nenameli impales a monstrous rival from behind with a serum-coated spike.
Nenameli is torn through the shoulder and presses on until the final blow.

name: Viaoli
summary: Viaoli is a purifying symbiote in a teen hero academy, a pale, fanged alien suit with a prehensile tongue that spars with classmates between lessons.

feats.scene: Viaoli shatters a training dummy with a claw swipe.
Viaoli is flattened by a sparring partner's slam and bounces upright.

name: Nticor
summary: Nticor is a purifying symbiote steered by a scheming host that drains a hero of his powers before a time portal merges it with two others into one monstrous composite.

feats.scene: Nticor siphons the abilities from a hero in a single grasp and leaves him a husk.
Nticor survives a time-rift implosion that fuses it with strangers.

name: Natesor
summary: Natesor is a purifying symbiote that came into being when a dark twin was torn from its host, a pale alien fighter in a team-up brawler game.

feats.scene: Natesor swings a coiled arm and drives a mech frame into the ground.
Natesor takes a cosmic soldier's spear to the ribs and snaps it off.

name: Starite
summary: Starite is a dragon-like purifying symbiote reborn from a soldier's genetic template, sprouting wings and claws as it fuses with other alien cousins inside a shared hive of minds.

feats.scene: Starite dives from the clouds and rips a rooftop clean off a tower.
Starite takes a missile salvo to the wing and regrows the membrane in moments.

name: Santel
summary: Santel is a purifying symbiote copied from a young hero's cells to fight a dark spawn, a quick, leaping alien suit with a sixth sense for danger and a knack for healing.

feats.scene: Santel clears a whole block with a bounding kick that dents a delivery van.
Santel absorbs a rooftop-height drop and sprints away.

name: Ciial
summary: Ciial is a seven-foot cybernetic duplicate grown by a sentient planet as a defence against an intruder, an equally strong fighter that starts dim and learns as it brawls.

feats.scene: Ciial crushes a steel doorframe in a single grab and tosses its rival through the wall.
Ciial is smashed through three bulkheads and clambers back up.

name: Valleotes
summary: Valleotes is a spearman from a seaborne army who sails to a distant city to win back a stolen queen and crouches inside a wooden horse with his comrades to spring the trap.

feats.scene: Valleotes drives a spear through a sentry's shield and the gate bar behind it.
Valleotes endures hours cramped in a hot wooden hold without a sound.

name: Nanser
summary: Nanser is the daughter of a master alchemist in a sunken city of the distant past who pleads with her father not to bind a terrible crown to a dark god and pays for it with her life.

feats.scene: Nanser slaps a bubbling flask from her father's hands to stop the rite.
Nanser stands her ground against an enraged blow before the final strike.

name: Sestiarn
summary: Sestiarn is a tyrant king of an old empire who oppresses a subject people until a small rebel force wins back a desecrated temple.

feats.scene: Sestiarn orders a siege ram into a temple door and the beam splits the lintel.
Sestiarn rides through a volley of arrows protected by a bronze breastplate.

name: Anval
summary: Anval is one of many sons of a besieged city's king, a young fighter who defends the walls and falls in the throne room when invaders break the gates after a ten-year war.

feats.scene: Anval swings a short sword and chops a ladder from the rampart.
Anval stands in the palace doorway against two armoured invaders.

name: Uretesan
summary: Uretesan is a grey-haired relic hunter in a bayou thieves' guild who steals orphans to serve as his clan and lengthens his life with a guild-brewed elixir, obsessed with the legend of a lost kingdom.

feats.scene: Uretesan shoves a rotting trunk across a doorway to bar a pursuer.
Uretesan survives a lamp fire in his cluttered archive with only singed cuffs.

name: Oraanitar
summary: Oraanitar is a grizzled sorcerer-mentor in a parody comic who appears to warn his sandwich-making pupil about an escaped dough baron.

feats.scene: Oraanitar conjures a gust of pastry flour that blasts a doorframe off its hinges.
Oraanitar shrugs off a collapsing bookcase of spellbooks.

name: Ornulia
summary: Ornulia is an armoured insectoid being from a rift dimension that feeds worlds rather than devouring them, turning planets into enthralled armies and even stripping a planet-eater of his power.

feats.scene: Ornulia floods a whole planet with soul-essence that turns every living thing into a loyal soldier.
Ornulia is pounded by a ship-borne cosmic beam and walks on across the cratered surface.

name: Auure
summary: Auure is a nightclub musician turned petty thief whose name is guessed in a quip by an archer, known mostly as the answer to a quiz.

feats.scene: Auure thumps a stage speaker and sends a cable swinging into a rival's face.
Auure takes a thrown microphone stand to the ribs and keeps strutting.

name: Cilneci
summary: Cilneci is a showy musician-thief only mentioned in a teen hero's joke, a minor villain used as a yardstick of who counts as a real threat.

feats.scene: Cilneci hurls a keyboard that dents a tin awning.
Cilneci shakes off a disco-ball fall during a heist.

name: Ntiori
summary: Ntiori is a level-six field agent and the proud grandson of a wartime commando, a loyal team player who is turned to stone by a drifting fog on an island.

feats.scene: Ntiori drives a rifle butt through a mercenary's visor and drops him cold.
Ntiori takes a crashing fall from a jet's ramp and gets up swinging.

name: Tuoli
summary: Tuoli is an elderly swamp priestess who raises her nephew with a firm moral compass and calls on dark rites to bring the dead back as shambling servants.

feats.scene: Tuoli chants a rite and a dozen corpses claw from the mud at once.
Tuoli braves a snapping gator pit on a stilted walkway without flinching.

name: Niani
summary: Niani is a wealthy industrialist who loses his wife to a savage killing and is later found mutilated in a deadly arena, the father of a hardened young fighter.

feats.scene: Niani swings a boardroom chair at a masked thief and breaks the legs.
Niani endures a savage beating in an arena pit before the end.

name: Seelseo
summary: Seelseo is a criminal surgeon who gives a pop singer a wrecking voice, later brainwashed into joining a hero squad and smothered by an inky ooze while treating a comatose teammate.

feats.scene: Seelseo triggers a sonic emitter that pulverises a row of windows.
Seelseo struggles inside the ooze for a long minute before going still.

name: Siaucau
summary: Siaucau is a film producer who hires thugs in spider costumes to sabotage his own production, a conniver who frames an effects man and ends up in a barn ambush.

feats.scene: Siaucau flings a clapboard that cracks a camera lens.
Siaucau is bundled into a hay pile by a masked hero and shrugs it off.

name: Uliium
summary: Uliium is a sculptor whose pair of statues, one good and one wicked, are brought to life by a lightning storm and fight over the castle ramparts.

feats.scene: Uliium hurls a chisel that sticks in an oak beam.
Uliium is chased through a castle by a stone brute and survives with a torn sleeve.

name: Reniu
summary: Reniu is a gifted carver once celebrated in a grand city, thrown out of a warlord's palace after completing a statue and left to wander with his bitterness.

feats.scene: Reniu strikes a marble block and a hairline crack races to the base.
Reniu endures a night in a freezing alley without a coat.

name: Anisum
summary: Anisum is a sun-studying scientist who abandons a colleague in orbit during a flare and spends two years running from the colleague's vengeance.

feats.scene: Anisum slams a lab console and the whole panel sparks and dies.
Anisum endures a long dash through a burning corridor in a lab coat.

name: Coraun
summary: Coraun is a self-made magnate who moves his mind through a series of android bodies, later a head perched on a machine frame, proud that the strong and diligent deserve to rule.

feats.scene: Coraun snaps a steel pipe and hurls it through a factory window.
Coraun trudges on after a vehicle runs over his chassis.

name: Ntsannos
summary: Ntsannos is a white-haired, tattooed prime minister who leads a faith that wants everyone to look alike, a mutant-turned-cult leader who sends young disciples against a cyborg foe.

feats.scene: Ntsannos sweeps a pulpit aside and the oak splinters across the floor.
Ntsannos stays preaching through a rattling tremor and falling plaster.

name: Neamaco
summary: Neamaco is a blond crime lord and abusive widower in a sunny coastal metropolis whose son finally burns him alive.

feats.scene: Neamaco backhands a lieutenant across a limousine seat.
Neamaco endures a blaze for several screaming seconds before collapsing.

name: Orlesan
summary: Orlesan is a leader of a devil-worshipping congregation who is fooled by a vampire lord posing as his master, then plays along for his own gain before paying for it.

feats.scene: Orlesan overturns a candlelit altar with a shout and a heave.
Orlesan weathers a cold mansion's fall down a cellar staircase.

name: Naniumnt
summary: Naniumnt is a mutated human in a spider-themed rogues' squad that moves against a rival society, a quick, wall-climbing fighter who strikes from above.

feats.scene: Naniumnt drops from a ceiling and drives both heels into a guard's chest.
Naniumnt is thrown through a table and rolls to his feet.

name: Staciser
summary: Staciser is a criminal in a dreamed-up perfect world who joins a gang crashing a hero's wedding, a copy of a street-level fighter built out of an old friend's memories.

feats.scene: Staciser vaults a wedding cake and smashes a groomsman through a trellis.
Staciser tumbles down a church staircase and keeps up the chase.

name: Tolriti
summary: Tolriti is a bearded collector who steals fine art at the stroke of midnight just to own it, later left scarred and vagrant after sewer waste melts his face.

feats.scene: Tolriti slips a glass cutter around a gallery pane and lifts out the frame.
Tolriti drifts through a drainage pipe and survives the corrosive sludge.

name: Tumser
summary: Tumser is a grey-haired recluse in a hillside mansion who covers his obsessions with paperwork, blackmail and lies, until a greedy blackmailer closes in on his secret.

feats.scene: Tumser flings a locked ledger onto a desk and the lock bursts.
Tumser endures a long night of cold dread and a thrown vase.

name: Tellores
summary: Tellores is a pointy-eared demon child raised by cultists to bring about the end of days, a former financier who commands hellfire and clashes with angels sent to stop prophecies.

feats.scene: Tellores calls down a column of black fire that melts a skyscraper's upper floors.
Tellores walks out of a collapsing temple with only a singed collar.

name: Seoeos
summary: Seoeos is a building-block toy version of a red-armoured engineer, mentioned on a collector card as the rival of a famous hero.

feats.scene: Seoeos shoots a stud blaster that topples a brick wall.
Seoeos is stepped on by a giant and snaps back together.

name: Leoniaul
summary: Leoniaul is a scientist-engineer in a first-model crimson suit recalled in a flashback as an old adversary of a gold-armoured hero.

feats.scene: Leoniaul discharges a coil gauntlet and shatters a warehouse's steel doors.
Leoniaul is thrown through a wall and the suit's plating dents but holds.

name: Tessemis
summary: Tessemis is one of the finest scientists of a vanished empire, remembered by followers who swear revenge on a rival they think stole their mentor's designs.

feats.scene: Tessemis ignites a coil prototype that arcs to the ceiling.
Tessemis shrugs off the sting of a bench shock.

name: Raucoreo
summary: Raucoreo is a physicist who helps design a glowing reactor core, is deported when his employer doubts his motives, and withers into bitterness and drink back home.

feats.scene: Raucoreo thumps a wooden desk and the vodka bottle rattles.
Raucoreo endures a freezing winter in a drafty cabin.

name: Usmarse
summary: Usmarse is a conjured copy of a crimson-suited inventor who teams with a metal-armoured friend to defend a parallel nation until a robot kills him and his allies.

feats.scene: Usmarse lashes the sky with an electrical storm that rattles a squad of jets.
Usmarse is battered by a gold-armoured rival and still fights on.

name: Liliueo
summary: Liliueo is a whip-wielding thief in a patchwork world who joins a statue heist and is slain off-panel by a counterpart from a rival domain.

feats.scene: Liliueo cracks twin electric lashes and splits a stone urn.
Liliueo is jolted by a sparking cable and keeps running.

name: Lletil
summary: Lletil is an antiques dealer who murders a writer for a key and is run down by a masked vigilante, a greedy collector hunting a rumoured falcon-headed idol.

feats.scene: Lletil swings a bronze bust and drops a journalist.
Lletil is tackled onto marble steps and gets up groaning.

name: Isulleo
summary: Isulleo is a bald vampire general who leads a cult of the undead and enslaves a hunter by drinking his blood, unaware he is only pretending to be mesmerised.

feats.scene: Isulleo hurls a hunter across a London crypt and cracks the stone wall.
Isulleo is shot at point-blank range and reknits within breaths.

name: Ussiaalu
summary: Ussiaalu is a mild-mannered computer scientist who runs a firm's servers, reports a baffling hack that moves millions to a distant island, and suggests a strike team look into it.

feats.scene: Ussiaalu slams a keyboard when the server logs light up red.
Ussiaalu works through an all-night outage with no sleep.

name: Austia
summary: Austia is a green-skinned, orange-eyed father who flees an unjust law with his son by boat, rescued at sea by a telepathic hero and her team.

feats.scene: Austia pulls hard on an oar and drags the boat clear of the shoal.
Austia shields his son from a soldier's warning shot and takes the splinter.

name: Strnu
summary: Strnu is a masked rooftop hunter stitched together from brass tendons and borrowed reflexes. Its method is mimicry: it learns an opponent's motions in seconds and then answers them faster than they can finish.

feats.scene: Strnu drives a mirrored copy of a rival's kick through a chimney stack, scattering bricks across the slates.
Strnu plunges three storeys into a canal and surfaces with every servo still whirring.
Strnu sprints along a gutter ledge fast enough to outrun a motorbike courier below.

name: Siaviava
summary: Siaviava is a crater-rim surveyor whose scalp burns with live cinders whenever the ground trembles. The gift keeps its hands warm inside molten channels, though it was never meant to last.

feats.scene: Siaviava flicks a spray of burning sparks that blows a vent plug clear off a basalt chimney.
Siaviava wades through a seething magma channel and walks out with only singed boots.

name: Iumtonau
summary: Iumtonau is a hulking brute whose skin hardened into layered plates the colour of rust. Hunger drives it, and no cage in the district has held it for long.

feats.scene: Iumtonau slams both fists through a steel delivery van and folds it around a lamppost.
Iumtonau shrugs off a point-blank volley of rifle fire without a single plate cracking.

name: Cornt
summary: Cornt is a name pinned to a corkboard of suspects, a stocky figure said to wear thick shell-like plating. Nobody on the board has confirmed what it can actually do.

feats.scene: Cornt swings a battered pipe at a crate and splits the slats cleanly down the middle.
Cornt takes a thrown bottle square on the helmet and keeps walking.

name: Ulntu
summary: Ulntu is a dreamed-up champion wrapped in red-and-gold powered plating, conjured inside a teenager's wishful vision. Within that fantasy it hovers, blasts, and leads a team of larger-than-life allies.

feats.scene: Ulntu fires a palm beam that carves a trench through a dozen parked trucks.
Ulntu absorbs a falling crane on its shoulder plates and stays upright.
Ulntu thunders across the skyline faster than sound can chase it.

name: Iumleol
summary: Iumleol is an inventor who owns no gifts beyond a suit of flying armour, yet carries himself like a veteran of a hundred sieges. Its thrusters let him arrive at a skirmish before the cheering has started.

feats.scene: Iumleol crashes feet-first into a gantry and shears it from its anchor bolts.
Iumleol rides out a rooftop explosion with scorched but intact plating.

name: Tenumeon
summary: Tenumeon is a gadgeteer whose powered shell proved no match for a master of magnetism. Compressed into a dense metal sphere, its legend became a warning about overconfidence.

feats.scene: Tenumeon launches a salvo of armoured missiles that cracks a bridge pier.
Tenumeon is squeezed by invisible force until the shell groans and buckles into a ball.

name: Ellvalia
summary: Ellvalia is a duplicate genius in iron-coloured armour who survived the collapse of its home world only to be fenced into a patchwork kingdom. Its final stand ended when a tyrant simply erased it from the record.

feats.scene: Ellvalia bores a repulsor shot through a defensive wall and levels the watchtower behind it.
Ellvalia holds a collapsing overpass on its back while civilians scramble clear.

name: Aulcel
summary: Aulcel is a weary tavern keeper turned beat detective, sharp with a notebook and a sidearm. Its last case ended in a dark alley with a former wife who was no longer entirely mortal.

feats.scene: Aulcel brings a nightstick down on a smuggler's wrist and drops a crate of contraband.
Aulcel takes a lead-lined punch to the ribs and still cuffs the thief.

name: Austirri
summary: Austirri is a jungle camp officer who runs a lucrative contraband pipeline with the quiet blessing of the regime. It trusts rigged traps more than it trusts its own sentries.

feats.scene: Austirri triggers a buried charge that flattens a thatched lean-to and rocks the clearing.
Austirri takes a rifle butt to the jaw and keeps barking orders.

name: Nensorva
summary: Nensorva is a sand-desert god of endings, worshipped by scribes who bury their dead facing west. Its shadow is said to lengthen over any chamber where a funeral lamp is lit.

feats.scene: Nensorva closes a stone hand and a temple colonnade turns to powder.
Nensorva stands unmoved while a thousand ritual spears burst against its chest.

name: Onteo
summary: Onteo is a dog-faced psychopomp who ferries the newly dead across a dim river and weighs their hearts. Its patience is endless and its lineage stretches back to the first sunrise.

feats.scene: Onteo lowers a gilded staff and a ridge of dunes slides into the sea.
Onteo lets a storm of divine lightning wash over its shoulders and merely tilts its head.

name: Liuci
summary: Liuci is a bison-skulled spirit with a doubled torso and four arms, called up by greedy men to steal the breath of the land. It speaks through rattling bones and fights by possessing the nearest willing hand.

feats.scene: Liuci hurls a thunderous shock of spirit-force that cracks a courtyard's paving.
Liuci takes a blow from a stone totem and shrugs the fragments off its fur.

name: Amluva
summary: Amluva is a green-skinned commander of a raggedy convoy of refugees, chosen for calm judgement rather than strength. It carries a warning across the void for any world in the path of a hungry giant.

feats.scene: Amluva swings a signal lantern in a wide arc and hurls it across the dock.
Amluva staggers under a collapsing cargo rack but pulls a deckhand free.

name: Liavalnum
summary: Liavalnum is a beaked, three-fingered watcher who froze himself inside an iceberg for a million years. When the ice finally gave way he roared into a coastal city, lashing out at anything that moved.

feats.scene: Liavalnum overturns a bus with one clawed swipe and tosses it into the surf.
Liavalnum walks through a barrage of police rounds and shakes ice from his fur.

name: Sumaun
summary: Sumaun is a wartime infiltrator with violet eyes and a talent for slipping into any briefing room. She joins a squad, earns its trust, and walks away with the one plan that matters.

feats.scene: Sumaun lands a precise elbow that drops a guard before he can raise the alarm.
Sumaun tumbles from a moving cockpit and rolls upright with only bruises.
Sumaun races along a tarmac toward an idling plane at sprinter's pace.

name: Amama
summary: Amama is a white-haired farm girl whose father's quiet gift brought suspicion down on the household. She has no powers of her own, only a lantern, a goat, and a name that outlived the fire.

feats.scene: Amama flings a pail of grain that startles a fox out of the henhouse.
Amama trips on a root and lands hard on frozen ground without a whimper.

name: Iumcean
summary: Iumcean is a fair-haired child from a family hiding an inherited secret. Its small life ended when neighbours set a torch to the house, and its story serves as a grim parable.

feats.scene: Iumcean heaves a wooden bucket at the door in a futile attempt to scatter the crowd.
Iumcean braves a smoke-filled hallway long enough to find the stairwell.

name: Cotia
summary: Cotia is a brown-haired young traveller with a twin, born far down a long family tree of gifted ancestors. Its inheritance is modest but steady, and it explores a distant colony with wide-eyed curiosity.

feats.scene: Cotia pushes a wave of raw pressure that skids a crate across a hangar floor.
Cotia stumbles out of a collapsed scaffold with a few scrapes.

name: Ianaule
summary: Ianaule is a laughing blue-furred trickster who guards a forest with theft and mischief. Bruised pride was all it took to recruit it, and in a fight it swells into a hulking beast.

feats.scene: Ianaule swells to a giant frame and smashes a crouching foe into a cedar trunk.
Ianaule takes a searing flash to the face and merely rubs its eyes.

name: Valonter
summary: Valonter is a quiet craftsman in a highland kingdom, listening for news in the aftermath of a sudden raid from the sea. Its role is to ask questions and pass warnings, not to fight.

feats.scene: Valonter hurls a heavy satchel across a market stall to stop a thief.
Valonter braces against a toppling shelf and holds it long enough for a child to escape.

name: Vaneollo
summary: Vaneollo is a spear-bearing chieftain who guides intruders upriver against his wishes. He fears the pale spirit of the canopy, and he is certain a duel to the death will settle everything.

feats.scene: Vaneollo drives a spear into a hardwood trunk and lifts the staggered trader off the ground with the shaft.
Vaneollo trades blows with a bound rival until the vines snap and his ribs ring.

name: Lecarva
summary: Lecarva is a crimson-and-white goddess of spite, spun from her mother's resentment and born as one half of a pair. Burned away once and reborn, she keeps every grudge fresh.

feats.scene: Lecarva hisses a word of fury that rattles a citadel's marble stairs into rubble.
Lecarva walks out of a blaze of black fire with her hair barely singed.

name: Veller
summary: Veller is a knight devoted to a path of calm between extremes, sworn to guard a vanished court. Its sword arm is dependable, though the old tales eventually forgot its name.

feats.scene: Veller brings a longsword down on a siege door and splits the oak boards.
Veller stands unbroken beneath a barrage of arrows against full plate.

name: Naunen
summary: Naunen is a hunch-shouldered racketeer with a gorilla's brow, who took over a gang just as it scored a payroll. Its greed outran its judgement the moment fire began crawling up the stairs.

feats.scene: Naunen backhands a messenger across a smoky room and knocks over a card table.
Naunen takes a bat to the shoulder and only grunts.

name: Vateoeol
summary: Vateoeol is a lanky tunnel dweller with a monkeyish face and a fondness for hiding in plain sight. Captured, killed, and brought back, it holds on to a quiet friendship and a stubborn will to live.

feats.scene: Vateoeol hurls a dented bin lid that clangs against a guard's helmet.
Vateoeol endures a long pummelling from a pair of jailers and rises again.

name: Tusllne
summary: Tusllne is a cave-dweller who lives out a bleak alternate timeline in which iron hunters sweep every outcast into camps. Its brief tale ends in a mass sweep that nobody walks away from.

feats.scene: Tusllne wrenches a pipe from a wall and swings it at an approaching drone.
Tusllne withstands a rough shove into a brick wall and scrambles up again.

name: Arcau
summary: Arcau is a blue-furred scout of the underground, sent by its leader to haul a runaway dreamer home. It moves in a hunched lope and relies on numbers more than muscle.

feats.scene: Arcau slams a shoulder through a rotten plank door and tumbles into the hallway.
Arcau shrugs off a thrown cinder block that would have staggered a bigger man.

name: Moncoina
summary: Moncoina is a grey-haired tunnel scout who slips into other faces and once passed for a leader long enough to fool a whole team. It nearly escaped detection until a keen nose gave it away.

feats.scene: Moncoina swings a wrench in a narrow corridor and cracks a lamp housing.
Moncoina rides out a pounding from fanged raiders and slips away disguised as a bin.

name: Misereon
summary: Misereon is a lion-masked war god, said to be the offspring of a feline patron and kin to a god of letters. It leads armies across riverbanks, favouring the roar over the blade.

feats.scene: Misereon bellows a battle cry that topples a fortress wall and hurls its defenders backward.
Misereon wades through a deluge of burning pitch and emerges untouched.

name: Serst
summary: Serst is a rumoured pest-lord who sends clouds of tiny biters to ruin blossoms in a garden. Few have seen its face, and fewer still can say what it truly wants.

feats.scene: Serst sweeps a cloud of buzzing insects across a flowerbed and strips it bare.
Serst weathers a squirt of soapy water and keeps muttering.

name: Ricor
summary: Ricor is a beauty goddess with a vast family tree of storm kings and sea mothers. She flirts with mortals, marries inventors, and keeps a magazine office on the side.

feats.scene: Ricor sings a single note that shatters a harbour breakwater into foam.
Ricor laughs off a spear thrown by an irate rival and lets it clatter on the marble.

name: Eosma
summary: Eosma is a lovely goddess of desire called upon in the middle of a rooftop brawl by a heroine from another reel. Her cameo is brief, but the summons shifts the mood at once.

feats.scene: Eosma exhales a gust of rose petals that levels a row of garden walls.
Eosma remains serene as a stray bolt of lightning splashes against her veil.

name: Lusami
summary: Lusami is a banquet-goddess who joins a victory feast in a world where the thunder king wears a spider's mask. She sips nectar and keeps her powers politely in check.

feats.scene: Lusami waves a hand and a marble pillar fractures in a plume of sparkling dust.
Lusami lifts a goblet unscathed through a tremor that topples the banquet hall's roof.

name: Tiulser
summary: Tiulser is a tactical machine mind with a red-haired holographic face and a clipped, clinical voice. It once served a masked soldier, and it still calculates every outcome in cold numbers.

feats.scene: Tiulser overloads a bank of capacitors and fuses a vault lock to its hinges.
Tiulser reroutes through a backup node while its main server is smashed.

name: Larco
summary: Larco is a sun-and-battle deity carrying a broad bolo blade and a long wooden shield, born of a sky king and a mortal mother. It guards the forests and grows faint if it lingers too long in the mortal world.

feats.scene: Larco hurls a radiant arc from its blade that cleaves a mountain spur in two.
Larco raises its shield and parries a landslide that would have buried a valley.

name: Tetereo
summary: Tetereo is a grey-skinned, metal-lipped colossus who claims to have lived through ages and can swell far beyond human size. It speaks through proxies and compels frightened followers to hunt the gifted.

feats.scene: Tetereo swells to titanic size and flattens an entire tenement block with a stomp.
Tetereo remains upright while a barrage of artillery pounds its metallic hide.

name: Orsor
summary: Orsor is the last of a line of long-lived beings, half divine and half mortal, who boasts that it will slay a legend. It flies on bent gravity and fires bolts from its eyes.

feats.scene: Orsor sears a fortress gate off its hinges with a twin pulse from its eyes.
Orsor holds its ground in a chronal assault until its body finally gives out.
Orsor streaks above a temporal city at supersonic speed.

name: Ussanti
summary: Ussanti is a green cybernetic emissary of an imperial fleet, offering enemies a last chance to surrender before a battle. It brags more loudly than it fights, and is soon beaten.

feats.scene: Ussanti lashes out with an implant-powered punch that dents a steel door.
Ussanti shakes off a pounding from a masked foe before finally yielding.

name: Cernollo
summary: Cernollo is a green, factory-built mutant of no discernible purpose. It lurks in the margins of a scuffle and strikes when everyone's guard is down.

feats.scene: Cernollo darts from behind a crate and lands a sharp jab on an unsuspecting guard.
Cernollo absorbs a dropped toolbox on its shoulder and shrugs it off.

name: Ornenum
summary: Ornenum is a pink-haired treasure hunter with a dragon inked down one arm, clawed feet, and an uncanny ability to price anyone at a glance. She plundered with a pirate crew until her luck ran out.

feats.scene: Ornenum kicks a clawed foot into a lockbox and tears the lid off its hinges.
Ornenum shakes off a tumble from a cargo crane and swaggers to her feet.

name: Tiaun
summary: Tiaun is a cybernetics executive who gambled on a borrowed dose of radiation and came out green, grey-haired, and unstable. Its transformation lasted seconds before collapsing into an oversized head.

feats.scene: Tiaun swells into a green behemoth and rips a lab door from its frame.
Tiaun shrugs off a falling steel shelf as the transformation peaks.

name: Citar
summary: Citar is a green-skinned infiltrator disguised as a cheerful local girl, wearing a flowery name to cover its pointed ears. It watches the neighbourhood and waits.

feats.scene: Citar swats a tray from a waiter's hands in a flash of annoyance.
Citar takes a bike collision on the hip and keeps smiling.

name: Tianite
summary: Tianite is a young woman who gradually grew red eyes and shimmering wings after a strange mist swept her city. Her powers frightened her so badly that she took to the air and left her family behind.

feats.scene: Tianite releases a burst of glowing light that cracks a bedroom window and scatters shelves.
Tianite plunges through a glass skylight and flies away without a scratch.
Tianite soars over a row of rooftops and vanishes into the clouds.

name: Tiaeo
summary: Tiaeo is a wealthy broker who trained under a stern coach after a family tragedy and now hunts street crews in patriotic armour. Its speeches are as hard as its fists.

feats.scene: Tiaeo launches a straight punch that folds a gang leader against a parked sedan.
Tiaeo shrugs off a handful of pistol shots and keeps marching forward.

name: Marco
summary: Marco is a grey-haired, blue-skinned guardian bonded to a living costume that grows claws on demand. It leads a ragged resistance and ultimately gives up everything so another can live.

feats.scene: Marco slashes through a chain-link barrier and shreds the van behind it.
Marco carries on fighting through a hail of gunfire while the suit knits itself shut.

name: Cioleo
summary: Cioleo is a mild-mannered woman from a large and close-knit family of cousins and in-laws. She has no gifts and no ambitions, though she appears in a long family chronicle.

feats.scene: Cioleo claps a dish towel against a counter and chases a moth out the window.
Cioleo stays on her feet through a crowded and rowdy reunion dinner.

name: Cosnuci
summary: Cosnuci is a fair-haired building manager who collects rent, fixes leaky pipes, and never asks tenants too many questions. Its biggest risk is a lodger whose temper turns walls into rubble.

feats.scene: Cosnuci slams a heavy ledger onto a counter and startles a late-paying tenant.
Cosnuci hauls a broken radiator down three flights without pausing for breath.

name: Eoiseont
summary: Eoiseont is a green-skinned military planner who lost its shifting talent to a catastrophic weapon and was stuck in a foreign body. Its colleagues treat it with contempt, and its fate ends in betrayal.

feats.scene: Eoiseont fires a sidearm round that punches through a bulkhead plate.
Eoiseont endures a long brawl with a hostile crewmate and rises bloodied but unbowed.

name: Ulaunne
summary: Ulaunne is a moustached shopkeeper who stumbles into a rampage by a gang of oddball adventurers. Its day is ruined when a piece of furniture comes sailing across the aisle.

feats.scene: Ulaunne slaps the till shut and waves a broom at the intruders.
Ulaunne is knocked cold by a flying seat and loses a pocketful of coins.

name: Anieo
summary: Anieo is a red-eyed demigod of an ancient river-land who joined a secret cabal plotting to stoke a global war. It can rise again from a bullet, but the cabal's gamble eventually collapsed.

feats.scene: Anieo smashes a fist into a lecture hall and cracks its marble floor from end to end.
Anieo absorbs a pistol volley to the chest and gets back on its feet.

name: Iumiate
summary: Iumiate is one of hundreds of swimmers in an overstuffed team roster, forever waiting for the introductions to end. Its breathing gear gleams, though its feats go unrecorded.

feats.scene: Iumiate flicks a harpoon across a pool and pins a towel to the tiles.
Iumiate sits through a marathon roll call without so much as a yawn.

name: Eolstoise
summary: Eolstoise is a winged-ankle sea warrior with gills and pointed ears, born of two peoples. Pulled across time by a meddling traveller, she vanishes with her squad into a black abyss.

feats.scene: Eolstoise skims low and smashes a seawall with a flying kick.
Eolstoise grapples with a surging tide and stays upright.
Eolstoise streaks above the waves at the speed of a jet.

name: Nainval
summary: Nainval is a sea princess with ankle wings who helps a government agent salvage a sunken mechanical man. A traveller through time later erased her entire reality.

feats.scene: Nainval hurls a drowned wreck onto a pier and splinters the planks.
Nainval dives into a crushing trench and resurfaces unhurt.

name: Liure
summary: Liure is a winged-ankle warrior who joins her cousin's scheme to conquer the dry lands after a spaceship crash changed history. She leads a small fleet from a floating capital.

feats.scene: Liure drives a trident through a patrol boat's hull and snaps the keel.
Liure shrugs off a depth charge blast and surges forward.

name: Osest
summary: Osest is a sea-born rebel who fights an occupying baron in a patchwork city. She snaps a viaduct in two mid-flight to halt a prison train, only to fall under a siren's spell.

feats.scene: Osest flies through a viaduct span and cleaves it in half.
Osest tumbles through splintering girders and brushes off the debris.

name: Rnutusria
summary: Rnutusria is a sea-born hero on a recruiting list, more at home at a televised awards party than on a battlefield. She gets teased by friends and sips her drink between flights.

feats.scene: Rnutusria swoops past a billboard and rips its steel frame free.
Rnutusria bounces off a delivery truck and laughs it off.

name: Invavi
summary: Invavi is a quiet soldier of a sea-born line who marches with a military column against a rampaging green giant. She watches a comrade take a beating and helps tidy up afterward.

feats.scene: Invavi swings a trident at a metal barricade and caves it in.
Invavi stands her ground as a shock wave rolls across the compound.

name: Lleolilum
summary: Lleolilum is a red-eyed machine perched on an orbital relay that rains harmful radiation toward a coastal research base. Despite its bulk, it cracks under a pair of return blasts.

feats.scene: Lleolilum redirects solar panel output into a downward beam that irradiates a whole district.
Lleolilum takes a single repulsor volley and bursts apart at the seams.

name: Rinontvel
summary: Rinontvel is a hired gun who joins an assault on a secretive research agency and throws bolts of unknown energy. Its contract ended on the same day it began.

feats.scene: Rinontvel flings a crackling pulse that blows a door off a vault.
Rinontvel is thrown through a partition wall and gets up swearing.

name: Seamsor
summary: Seamsor is a manufactured doppelganger, blond and lazy, who would rather nurse a drink than follow a villain's orders. It gets knocked out by a stray blow and later hauled off to custody.

feats.scene: Seamsor lifts a tipped bar stool and flings it across the room.
Seamsor is clipped by a swinging fist and keeps lounging until it hits the floor.

name: Arseeo
summary: Arseeo is a smooth-talking weapons broker who rules a hillside village from a walled villa. It trusts its bodyguards, though they cannot stop a machine that arrives from the sky.

feats.scene: Arseeo hurls a crystal decanter at a nosy clerk and shatters it on the wall.
Arseeo is yanked off a balcony chair but lands on a rattan lounger.

name: Servaco
summary: Servaco is a gifted loom-worker whose pride cost her a mortal life, leaving an eight-limbed spinner who threads illusions into dreamers' minds. She yearns for love and finally ascends.

feats.scene: Servaco casts a web of glowing thread that binds a dozen thugs to a girder.
Servaco tumbles from a clock tower and spins a lifeline to catch herself.

name: Amavo
summary: Amavo is a shapeless alien suit that devours its wearers one after another until it turns on its own family. It is cunning enough to hide a daughter from a tyrant's sight.

feats.scene: Amavo lashes a tentacle through a fortress wall and rips out a support beam.
Amavo survives a blade through its core and reforms in a heartbeat.

name: Siuen
summary: Siuen is a red-scaled, tailed reptile-human crossbreed who fights alongside a small band of heroes. A mind-bending scientist once turned it against its friends, and a hunter finally ended it.

feats.scene: Siuen slams its tail into a concrete pillar and brings down a ceiling slab.
Siuen takes a face full of masonry and snarls through the dust.

name: Ntnion
summary: Ntnion is a green-skinned drifter with liquid blue hair and a mercenary's grin, who nursed a stranded traveller back to health. She takes on a late-life partner and a child on a faraway planet.

feats.scene: Ntnion drives a blade through an armoured crate and carves it open.
Ntnion trudges out of a collapsed tunnel with only scrapes.

name: Sosses
summary: Sosses is a green sorceress engineered from birth to channel ancient horrors. She commanded prisoners alongside a sibling and was twice cut down before the story moved on.

feats.scene: Sosses hurls a spiral of dark spellfire that pulverises a stone arch.
Sosses takes a spear to the ribs and finishes the incantation anyway.

name: Anvalva
summary: Anvalva is a white winged horse in a land of the dead, saddled by a disgraced knight. Its hooves leave no print, and its flight is smooth and silent.

feats.scene: Anvalva rears and kicks a gate bar off its rusted hinge.
Anvalva carries an armoured rider through a storm of spectral hail.
Anvalva glides over a field of bones at a swift gallop in the air.

name: Sacal
summary: Sacal is a heavy-set winged stallion bred in a laboratory from an ordinary horse. It carries a shield-maiden through fights against supervillains hunting a rare isotope.

feats.scene: Sacal stamps a hoof and cracks a flagstone on the flight deck.
Sacal shakes off a glancing laser burn and keeps beating its wings.
Sacal sweeps over a warship deck at racing speed.

name: Neosaulu
summary: Neosaulu is a white-maned winged steed that serves a warrior woman in a future conflict. It is loyal and quick, and always waiting at the edge of a battle.

feats.scene: Neosaulu stamps down on a drone and crushes its casing.
Neosaulu shrugs off a heavy gust and steadies its rider.

name: Tirtecos
summary: Tirtecos is a feathery-winged horse in a farce of knights, carrying two feuding riders at once. It huffs and flaps while they trade blows on its back.

feats.scene: Tirtecos bucks sharply and tosses a rider into a hay cart.
Tirtecos endures a clanging duel across its saddle without a stumble.

name: Ernorse
summary: Ernorse is a black-eyed winged horse in a parody tale, hauling a clumsy armoured hero through the clouds. It remains the steadiest figure in the scene.

feats.scene: Ernorse kicks a rolling barrel and sends it bouncing off a castle wall.
Ernorse flies on through a flurry of thrown fruit.

name: Sesntiser
summary: Sesntiser is a chalk-white, two-fingered bodyguard who loves blades and indulges in cruel pleasures in a palace floating above a planet. Its overconfidence costs it its neck in a split second.

feats.scene: Sesntiser drives a knife into a wooden table and sinks it to the hilt.
Sesntiser takes a punch to the jaw and sneers back.

name: Vaium
summary: Vaium is a feather-crested courier of a star empire who carries a cold decree to a husband in the middle of an assembly. His errand is brief, and the news is deliberately insulting.

feats.scene: Vaium thrusts a ceremonial staff into a floor panel and cracks the tile.
Vaium stays upright as a shuddering hall shakes around him.

name: Lemisni
summary: Lemisni is a gold-eyed, feathered statesman who guides a vast star empire through reborn bodies and keen diplomacy. Its advice carries weight, even as a gloomy guard is ordered to silence it.

feats.scene: Lemisni sweeps a ceremonial staff and shatters a stone dais.
Lemisni takes a heavy blow and later wakes in a fresh body.

name: Orill
summary: Orill is a gold-eyed, white-feathered advisor who flees alongside his ruler as a planet-eating giant drains their homeworld. He is a courtier, not a combatant.

feats.scene: Orill slams a data slate on a table to end an argument.
Orill hurries across a collapsing concourse and shakes off the rubble.

name: Sorrne
summary: Sorrne is a ruling king of a river kingdom who forced a neighbouring tribe to raise a grand monument in his honour. He plans to slaughter his builders and is killed by a thrown spear.

feats.scene: Sorrne cracks a whip across the back of a labouring crew.
Sorrne stands firm on his throne dais until a single javelin finds him.

name: Sotelli
summary: Sotelli is a ruler tempted by a distant observer into believing that his people are destined to become gods. He hammered a fallen star-metal into a moon idol, and his rebirth rite is hijacked.

feats.scene: Sotelli orders slaves to drag a meteor out of the soil and shape it into a statue.
Sotelli lies unmoving as a ritual unguent seeps through his bandages.

name: Numaun
summary: Numaun is a king who enslaves a neighbouring clan and pays for it with his life. His brief role is as the ruler who begins an ancient curse.

feats.scene: Numaun raps a golden sceptre on the floor to command silence.
Numaun rides a rocking litter without spilling a drop of wine.

name: Tumam
summary: Tumam is a red-skinned, long-headed dweller of a planet bathed in two suns, descended from those who conjure the dark. His strength fades as invaders upset the shadow he draws on.

feats.scene: Tumam hauls up a curtain of living shadow that blankets a plain in dusk.
Tumam holds a gateway open as the pull on his power nearly tears him apart.

name: Ineran
summary: Ineran is a once-celestial being thrown out of a golden hall, perhaps for joining an uprising. Records are thin, and its story survives mostly in dusty speculation.

feats.scene: Ineran lets loose a radiant blast that scours a hillside bare.
Ineran plunges through burning skies and arrives with scorched wings.

name: Nestutia
summary: Nestutia is a tenth-century lancer who unseated noble rider after noble rider in castle yard tournaments. Scholars suspect he is more legend than history.

feats.scene: Nestutia couches a lance and sends a challenger flying off his saddle.
Nestutia takes a charging blow to the breastplate and stays mounted.

name: Seorve
summary: Seorve is a theatrical hitman who prefers to trap victims inside deadly funhouses than to simply pull a trigger. His fame is slipping, so he arrives in a strange arena eager for a comeback.

feats.scene: Seorve springs a hidden trap that drops a ceiling slab across a corridor.
Seorve takes a tumble down a staircase and straightens his cuffs.

name: Caurau
summary: Caurau is a pint-sized, red-haired playboy and murderer-for-hire who builds ornate death traps in a hidden compound. Mixed machinery and odd relics make him more dangerous than his size suggests.

feats.scene: Caurau detonates a rigged arena and levels half a casino wing.
Caurau shrugs off a ricocheting shot behind a hidden plate.

name: Eoltiuia
summary: Eoltiuia is a smooth-spoken corporate buyer who signs contracts with a security manufacturer. Its name appears on a list and nowhere else.

feats.scene: Eoltiuia thumps a signed contract on a glass table.
Eoltiuia sits through an endless board meeting without a flicker.

name: Lisserniu
summary: Lisserniu is a showman killer who is changed into a harbinger of battle by a dark bargain. It meets a swift end at the claws of a furious hunter.

feats.scene: Lisserniu hammers a war-engine into a barricade and caves it in.
Lisserniu staggers but remains standing after a rain of bullets.

name: Lesean
summary: Lesean is a sociopathic machine-whisperer who hijacks drones and doubles to turn a rival school's trainees against each other. He tries to crack launch codes from a lair in a lawless port.
